Loc de muncă dotat cu tehnica necesară.

Dezvoltarea și mentenanța aplicațiilor pentru dispozitive iOS.

Experiență în dezvoltarea aplicațiilor mobile pentru platforma iOS folosind limbajul Swift, SwiftUI.

Cunoștințe de bază în OOP.
Experiență în lucrul cu modele arhitecturale, cum ar fi MVC, MVVM.

vacancy-content:
Senior DevOps Engineer
Welcome to KIVORK, where innovation meets inspiration! As an international IT product company, we pride ourselves on designing and creating products that make a difference. We believe in our people and their potential to transform the travel industry.
Join Our Global Team:
Diverse and inclusive:
Be a vital part of KIVORK’s diverse team, prioritizing employee well-being.
Global Presence:
Engage with over 1000 talented individuals across offices in the Republic of Moldova, USA, and remote teams spread across Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Georgia, and more.
Crafting Experiences:
Be a part of a team that doesn't just build tools but crafts compelling experiences, reshaping the future of travel.
Empowering Professionals:
We empower our professionals to focus on delivering extraordinary customer experiences, redefining the essence of their roles.
Essential Expertise:
With over 5 years of experience in DevOps, focusing on AWS and Linux environments
Mastery of Linux administration and TCP/IP networking
Extensive AWS experience, including Route53, EC2, EKS, RDS, IAM, and SES
Proficient in Kubernetes and Ansible
Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases such as MySQL, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and ClickHouse
Expertise in Prometheus and Grafana for effective system monitoring
Possesses a problem-solving mindset with a focus on long-term solutions
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and levels of the organization
Key Contributions:
Ensures optimal configuration and maintenance of both dedicated servers and cloud infrastructure
Develop and implement DevOps strategies to streamline development workflows, increase efficiency, and improve deployment processes
Continuously improves infrastructure for better high availability, fault tolerance, and cost-efficiency
Vigilantly monitors infrastructure and applications, preempting and resolving issues
Upholds and enhances compliance with GDPR and SOC2 standards
Serves as a Kubernetes champion, empowering product teams through expertise in effective application management
Distinctive Advantages:
Work on exciting projects in a supportive team environment
Stable career with growth opportunities
Attractive salary and comprehensive benefits
Professional development and learning opportunities
Application Process:
Eager to make a substantial impact in the travel industry? Hit the 'Apply' button, and let's embark on this journey together.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
KIVORK is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Our employment decisions are made based on qualifications, experience, and business requirements, ensuring equal opportunities for all individuals.

vacancy-content:
Data Steward
We're seeking a Data Steward
to become part of our team.
Key Responsibilities:
Responsible for the maintenance of Business Metadata of Datasets and Data Elements (Columns, Tables, Schemas) in quality high and in sync with the Information Models
Develop and maintain the data flow map, understand all connections of the currently (and steadily increasing) end to end processes across the involved functions and processes within as well as beyond own Data Domain.
Support Data Domain Owner with analysis of DQ issues and creation of mitigation strategies
Contribute to the Design and implementation of processes to clean, transform, and aggregate raw data into the curated data layer.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of logic data models that accurately represent business entities and relationships.
Contribute to updates to the curated data layer to accommodate changes in logical models or business needs.
Implement data quality checks, define test scenarios, carry out testing and define validation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Identify and troubleshoot data issues, perform root cause analysis and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
Facilitate data classification, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
Develop and maintain data documentation and metadata repositories.
Qualification and Expertise:
MSc or BSc in Informatics, Data Science or equivalent
Experience with AWS services related to data processing and analytics.
Experience with SQL and database programming.
Knowledge of data modeling, ETL development, and data warehousing principles.
Experience with data quality tools, data cataloging and modeling, and metadata management (e.g. Innovator)
Experience with Veeva Vault is a plus.
Required Skills and Competencies:
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data quality and accuracy.
Proactive in identifying and resolving data issues
We are appreciated for:
Daily shared lunches
Prepaid Udemy and Laracast accounts
Referral bonus for internal and external recommendations
Fun ways to relax: PlayStation, table tennis
Corporate events for employees
Beverage fridge, free coffee, tea, fresh fruits
Modern equipment
Official employment and social package
Modern and comfortable workplace

to join a company as UNIQUE as YOU are!

www.backstageitcareers.com
or call us: 069369494.

Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
WE ARE AMDARIS
We fuse together exceptional talent who deliver outstanding software solutions our blended model of resources across Europe.
We are growing aggressively and we are now looking for a
Senior
DevOps Engineer (AWS)
to embark on an international project and work with the latest technologies alongside the brightest minds in a collaborative and energetic work environment. We are offering stimulating salaries plus a great range of benefits, including the opportunity of building and enhancing yourself a successful career within a highly reputable organisation. A great team mentality is essential with the ability to lead by example and promote good team spirit and collaboration.
We bring together the best talent and next-level ideas to create outstanding solutions. With 40% year on year growth every year under our belt over the past four years, we have big plans for the future. Our growth plan is ambitious and our projects take software to the next level, so join our team in the centre of Chisinau.
ROLE INTRO
We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer with a strong focus on AWS to join our team. The primary responsibility of this role is to collaborate with internal software engineers, system operators, and other IT staff members to manage and optimize code releases within a suite of cloud-based software applications. You will be instrumental in bridging the gaps between development, testing, and operations teams, aiding in the integration of new systems, managing AWS-based infrastructure, and overseeing the deployment and maintenance of applications on AWS.
As a DevOps Engineer, you must be adaptable to the fast-paced nature of the tech industry, where changes in requirements, goals, strategies, and emerging AWS technologies are common. The role requires you to interact, develop, engineer, and communicate effectively at technical levels with clients, vendors, partners, and all stakeholders. Your key objective will be to automate and streamline our clients’ software application suite on AWS, including the specification and documentation of new features and the ongoing maintenance of critical business applications.
The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge combined with excellent interpersonal skills. A strong understanding of AWS services, cloud-based applications, and the ability to diagnose and resolve application issues in an AWS environment are essential.
REQUIREMENTS
Extensive work experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar software engineering role, with a strong focus on AWS.
Deep knowledge of AWS services, including but not limited to EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, or ECS/EKS for container management.
Experience with container orchestration services, especially Kubernetes, within AWS (EKS).
Proven experience with agile software development processes and languages such as Go, C/C++, Java, or JavaScript.
Experience administering and deploying development CI/CD tools, particularly in AWS environments, such as AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and Jenkins on AWS.
Significant experience with both Windows and Linux operating system environments, particularly within AWS EC2 instances.
Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using AWS CloudFormation or Terraform.
Experience with infrastructure scripting solutions such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
Working knowledge of AWS database services and SQL, including RDS, DynamoDB, and Aurora.
Strong problem-solving attitude and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Communication skills in English B2
BENEFITS
Opportunities for certification and training
Internal referral bonus up to EUR 1.000
English courses
Gym allowance
Medical Reimbursement
Full salary covered up to 20 days of sickness
Flexible working hours
Loyalty scheme
Team building activities, special events and conferences
UK/EU Travel opportunities
Snacks and drinks in the office

vacancy-content:
QA Automation Engineer (GameDev)
Вы строите автоматизированную «страховочную сетку» вокруг клиента (Unity), бэкенда (micro-services, Firebase) и live-сервисов. Всё, что можно проверить машиной — проверяется машиной. Работаете в паре с Manual QA и DevOps, влияете на definition-of-done и качество на всех стадиях.
Чем предстоит заниматься
Разработка и поддержка автоматизированных тестов для игровых клиентов (PC, консоли, мобильные платформы) и бэкенд-сервисов.
Поддержка тест-фреймворка. Python + Pytest или C# + Unity Test Framework / GameDriver; BDD (Gherkin) для high-level сценариев.
CI/CD-интеграция - GitHub Actions + Docker; кэш артефактов, параллельный запуск, отчет Allure / ReportPortal.
Release Gate-проверки - Smoke/Regression/Performance и platform compliance (Meta Quest VRC/ Oculus, Android,iOs).
Observability & Flaky tests - Логирование (ELK / Loki), метрики (Grafana, Prometheus), авто-ретраи и quarantine.
Нагрузочные сценарии - k6/Locust для API и Photon/FishNet нагрузочных сценариев мультплеера.
Валидация билдов - Снимки GPU-кадров (RenderDoc), memory-профайлы, FPS / frame-time трекинг.
Подготовка тест-данных - Stub/Mock серверов, генерация save-files, скрипты миграций БД.
Мы ожидаем
2+ года автоматизации тестов производственного уровня (желательно — игры, XR-проекты или high-load онлайн-сервисы).
Уверенный Python или C#; знание ООП, паттернов Page/Object Model и SOLID.
Практика с Playwright (Web), Appium (mobile), Unity Test Framework / GameDriver или аналогами.
Опыт написания тестов для REST / GraphQL / WebSocket; Postman / Swagger.
Знание Git-flow, Docker, базовых bash-скриптов.
Настройка CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins + Docker executors).
Разумное понимание сетевых протоколов (UDP/TCP, lag-simulation) и client-server архитектуры.
Будет плюсом
Знание Sentry, Crashlytics, GameAnalytics, Prometheus/Grafana alerting.
Подготовка билдов к Steam Deck / Meta Quest / Nintendo Lotcheck.
Инфраструктура тестов в AWS Device Farm / Azure PlayFab.
SQL (ClickHouse / BigQuery), NoSQL (Firebase RTDB, CosmosDB).
Скрипты на TypeScript для web-админок или внутриигровых тулов.
Сертификаты ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer или аналогичные.
У нас классно!
Официальное трудоустройство с полным социальным пакетом. IT-парк. Оплачиваемый отпуск 28 дней.
Большой уютный офис в центре города со специально оборудованными зонами для отдыха и релаксации в течение рабочего дня.
Стандартный рабочий график с 9:00 до 18:00 с часовым перерывом на обед. Возможность сдвига рабочего времени на час раньше или позже.
Поддержка карьерного роста и международного общения с помощью курсов английского языка.
Рабочее место, оснащенное современным оборудованием, обеспечивающее комфорт и эффективность. Широкий выбор литературы в корпоративной библиотеке для саморазвития и профессионального роста.
Выделение бюджета на курсы и тренинги для повышения профессиональных навыков.
Возможность посещать зарубежные профессиональные конференции и выставки для изучения последних трендов и технологий индустрии.
Регулярные team-building-и и мероприятия, укрепляющие командный дух (квизы, спортивные марафоны, конкурсы, кибертурниры и многое другое). Семейные мероприятия для сотрудников.
Компенсация абонементов в фитнес-клубы.
Систематический пересмотр заработной платы, обеспечивающий справедливую и конкурентоспособную оплату труда.
Чай, кофе, снеки и свежие фрукты для поддержания энергии и хорошего настроения в течение всего рабочего дня.

Solution Architect
Orange Systems
is the IT hub of Orange Moldova. An IT park resident, with over 850 employees, that delivers advanced IT solutions, enhancing a wide range of activities and full cycle development, impacting millions of customers across Europe.
Orange Systems is looking for a for a talented and experienced Solution Architect.
As a solution architect role, you will be responsible to providing the groundwork for software development projects by tailoring IT solutions to specific business needs that requires both technical and interpersonal skills to design, describe, and manage IT solutions, cloud or on prem. You will evaluate the existing environment and work out with different elements of business, information, and technology to solve a problem ensuring all standards regarding resilience, security, performance, availability, and cost-effectiveness design is applied.
You will work closely with developers, other IT professionals and with top-level management decision-makers, demonstrating the business value of suggested technical initiative.
what you will be doing:
Design and implement multi-cloud architectures and build hybrid environments.
Develop and implement cloud and on-prem architecture (AS-IS and TO-BE), assess technical feasibility, oversee migrations, and address corresponding issues.
Lead the design, planning, and implementation of end-to-end infrastructure and cloud-agnostic solutions.
Design and implement robust, cloud-native solutions using Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Apply Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework to ensure adherence to best practices in operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
Advise on infrastructure architecture discussions, environment strategy, and hosting requirements.
Maintain and deploy Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK.
Advise customers on AWS/Azure governance, cost-saving initiatives, and achieving organization-wide standards.
Define and develop architectural roadmaps to meet business goals, modernization efforts, and cost planning.
Execute hands-on implementation of proposed solutions and provide technical guidance to teams during development and deployment phases.
Implement scalable, high-performance hosting solutions for private and public cloud technologies.
Collaborate with business units and engineering teams to develop short- and long-term solution/data strategies.
what we are looking for:
Working experience with microservice architectures and Kubernetes etc.
Experience with Docker containers and container orchestration tools such as EKS/AKS.
Ability to evaluate custom and third-party solutions to enhance organizational performance and customer experience.
Proficiency with AWS/Azure cloud platforms across SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services, designing technical solutions based on requirements.
Strong working knowledge of cloud services such as AWS (e.g., Kubernetes, Lambda, S3, ECS, EMR).
Experience in implementing CI/CD setups using DevOps tools like Jenkins, CodeBuild, CodeCommit, CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline.
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL database technologies (e.g., RDS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, SQLServer).
Familiarity with programming languages such as NextJS, TypeScript, and Python.
Expertise in cloud-native application development, CI/CD pipelines, and container orchestration using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Familiarity with network function virtualization (NFV), SDN, and 5G technologies is a plus.
Experience in cloud security with a focus on Zero Trust security models and application security principles.
Familiarity with API management and API security following OWASP API Security guidelines.
Ability to work with architect tools such as Enterprise Architect.
Fluency in English is essential with Excellent interpersonal skills.

Unique learning experience in our company
Working experience with great potential for growth
Competitive salary

We fuse together exceptional talent who deliver outstanding software solutions. Our approach has helped us grow 60% in 2021, 94% in 2022, while in 2023 we joined forces with Insight, a Fortune 500 company and a leading solutions and systems integrator. With exciting growth plans and cutting-edge projects, there has never been a better time to join our incredible team.
About The Job
We are expanding rapidly and are on the lookout for an ambitious, detail-oriented
Golang Developer
to join our dynamic team. This is a unique opportunity for analytical thinkers and strong communicators who are eager to make a significant impact on our company's growth and the success of our clients.
As a
Senior Golang Developer
, you will play a crucial role in bridging the gap between IT and business objectives, driving projects that enhance efficiency and innovation. We offer competitive salaries and an excellent range of benefits, along with the chance to shape your career within a highly respected organization, collaborating with top-tier client brands.
Golang Developer Responsibilities
The main purpose of the role is to write clean and scalable code using GO programming languages, testing and deploying applications and systems to improve existing software. You will participate in requirements analysis and prioritising tasks in collaboration with internal teams. To produce software design and architecture and revise, update, refactor and debug code. You will have to develop Go packages and programs that are scalable and maintainable in a timely and efficient manner.
As a Golang Developer, you will have to develop documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC). You will serve as an expert on applications, providing technical support for programs and applications to customers and other team members. Engaging with key stakeholders, internal and external to provide expertise and technical leadership to functional project teams. Part of your role is to understand of how best to leverage and exploit the language's unique paradigms, idioms, and syntax.
The successful Golang Developer will use analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions which may include a variety of complex business requirements. You will need to have the ability to learn new products and technologies as they become available to find the best methods for using them.

Strong knowledge of Go programming language, paradigms, constructs, and idioms
Strong knowledge of Python
Experience in Cloud Environments: AWS/Azure

Esempla Systems, Chisinau
Role Overview:
We are looking for a highly skilled

vacancy-content:
C/C++ Software Developer
WE ARE AMDARIS
We fuse together exceptional talent who deliver outstanding software solutions. Our approach has helped us grow 60% in 2021, 94% in 2022, while in 2023 we joined forces with Insight, a Fortune 500 company and a leading solutions and systems integrator. With exciting growth plans and cutting-edge projects, there has never been a better time to join our incredible team.
C/C++ SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
We are experiencing rapid growth and are seeking to expand our team with skilled C/C++ Developers to support an international software development project. Our focus is on fostering a collaborative environment where team members can build rewarding careers, and we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. You will thrive in a team-oriented setting, consistently leading by example.
In partnership with one of our key clients, a leading provider of healthcare software, IT solutions, and related services, we are looking for Mid and Senior-level C/C++ Developers to join our team and contribute to this impactful project.
ABOUT THE ROLES
In this role, you will play a pivotal part in reshaping the communication framework between the client and server by removing the Proxy application and introducing more secure protocols like TLS 1.2, along with implementing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for enhanced security.
You will delve deep into the C-based server applications, which are heavily integrated with SQL stored procedures, ensuring that communication protocols are not only optimized but also fortified with stronger security measures. As a key contributor to the project, you will collaborate closely with the team to address and resolve known security vulnerabilities in client-side/ server-side codebases, driving the overall improvement of the system's architecture and resilience.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist in analyzing software requirements for client-side/ server-side and help design robust solutions.
Produce well-designed, testable, and efficient C/C++ code based on project-specific requirements, especially focusing on networking and security enhancements.

Mid/Senior Backend developer (PHP/Symfony)

Academia Internațională de IT pentru Copii impact A&C
Noi suntem impact A&C, o academie internațională de IT pentru copii. Am început activitatea noastră în 2017, în Moldova, iar astăzi avem peste 80 de filiale în 21 de țări. HOT SOFTWARE
- за динамику и открытость, поэтому в нашей компании царит предпринимательский дух, сочетание азарта и сплочённости, страсть к успеху. Мы создаём высокопродуктивную среду и не боимся преград. Наш успех основан на людях и технологиях. Наша культура — это то, что делает Hot Software интересным и вознаграждаемым местом для работы. Мы выступаем за разнообразие и всегда ищем новые способы удивить клиентов.

развитие
амбиции
командная работа
ответственность
гибкость

Опыт работы не менее 3 лет в области веб-разработки с акцентом на верстке.
Глубокие знания HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript. Опыт работы с фреймворками, такими как Angular или Vue.js.
Знание и опыт применения принципов отзывчивого и адаптивного дизайна.
Умение оптимизировать код и ресурсы для повышения производительности.
Опыт работы с инструментами верстки, такими как Sass, Less или PostCSS.
Опыт работы с системами управления версиями, такими как Git.
Знание основ SEO и принципов доступности.
Отличные коммуникативные навыки и способность эффективно взаимодействовать в коллективе.

Отвечать за создание высококачественных, адаптивных и кросс-браузерных веб-страниц с использованием HTML, CSS и других современных технологий верстки.

Интегрировать верстку с серверной частью, взаимодействовать с бэкэнд-разработчиками и другими членами команды.
Гарантировать качественную кросс-платформенную совместимость.
Эффективно взаимодействовать с дизайнерами, разработчиками и другими участниками проекта.
Осуществлять тестирование верстки на различных устройствах и браузерах, обеспечивать ее корректность и эффективность.
Следовать лучшим практикам верстки и стандартам кодирования.
Поддерживать актуальность знаний в области технологий верстки.

.NET Core (AWS, Lambda) Developer
We’re growing rapidly and are looking for
.NET Core (AWS, Lambda) Developer
professionals to embark on an international software development project. The role will put the latest technologies at your fingertips in a talented, collaborative team and high-energy work environment. We want everyone to build a career they can be proud of and will support you in your development from day one. You’ll be happy to work in a team and lead by example every day.
WE ARE AMDARIS
We connect the right people with the right tasks for fantastic outcomes. We’ve grown 40% every year for the last four years, and we’re still getting bigger. With an incredible growth plan and exciting projects from day one, now is the time to join our fantastic team.
SOFTWARE DEVELOPER DESCRIPTION
SOFTWARE Professionals build the back-end (C#, NET Core, Lambda) and front-end (React.js) design of websites and software applications. They create design plans for the user-facing side of applications, which controls look, feel, and function.
They also structure the back part of an application, which manages program logic and server database interaction. A full-stack professional is trained to understand what is going on between these two interfaces and possesses the variety of software skills needed to work on both. People with a strong desire to learn a multitude of technologies and programming languages with a can-do attitude will thrive in this role. Full-stack professionals are problem-solvers, working in a fast-paced, collaborative office environment alongside other engineers.
SOFTWARE DEVELOPER RESPONSIBILITIES
Developing a back-end website applying MediatR (NET library).

vacancy-content:
System Analyst, Direcția core banking, Departamentul tehnologii informaționale
Echipa Direcției core banking este în căutarea unui coleg pentru poziția de
System Analyst.
Obiectivul postului este analiza și asigurarea funcționalității infrastructurii, sistemelor informaționale și produselor software.
Ce vei face:
Colectarea, analiza și stabilirea cerințelor sistemului și definirea sarcinilor pentru dezvoltarea sau modificarea sistemelor informatice.
Pregătirea și coordonarea documentației tehnice, inclusiv specificații funcționale și soluții de proiectare.
Dezvoltarea și evaluarea specificațiilor funcționale și de integrare.
Evaluarea implementărilor arhitecturale software și propunerea de îmbunătățiri.
Conducerea sesiunilor de grooming cu echipele de dezvoltare pentru clarificarea și descompunerea sarcinilor.
Dezvoltarea și actualizarea mapărilor de date și a designurilor de interfață.
Proiectarea, testarea și implementarea sistemelor noi.
Ce căutăm:
Minimum 2 ani de experiență ca analist în proiecte de dezvoltare software.
Capacitate de a analiza și documenta procesele de afaceri și cerințele sistemului.
Competențe avansate în examinarea surselor de date, recunoașterea modelelor și analiza datelor.
Experiență în analiza cross-platform și în proiectarea integrărilor sistemelor, în special cu sisteme cu sarcini mari.
Înțelegere aprofundată a tehnologiilor de integrare REST, SOAP, XML, XSD și altele.
Competențe avansate în SQL și experiență cu proiectarea interogărilor complexe pentru baze de date relaționale.
Familiarizare cu metodologiile ciclului de viață al dezvoltării software (SDLC).
Excelente abilități de comunicare, cu capacitatea de a negocia și explica detalii tehnice părților interesate non-tehnice.
Capacitate dovedită de a evalua beneficiile și riscurile soluțiilor software și de a comunica eficient acestea membrilor echipei.
Gândire creativă și abilități de rezolvare a problemelor, cu aptitudini pentru găsirea soluțiilor inovatoare.
Cunoștințe despre principiile Agile și cadru SCRUM.
Experiență cu instrumente de management al proiectelor și colaborare: Jira și Confluence.
Va constitui un avantaj experiența cu instrumente de modelare a datelor, familiaritatea cu mediile cloud precum AWS sau Azure și competențe în utilizarea UML pentru designul sistemelor.
Ce beneficii vei avea:
Program individual de dezvoltare profesională şi avansare în carieră;
Bonus de performanță în dependență de rezultatele tale;
Instruirea continuă pentru dezvoltarea abilităților profesionale și personale;
Participarea la diferite cluburi de interes și team building-uri organizate de către echipa noastră;
Condiții avantajoase la produsele băncii pentru angajați.
Expediază CV-ul şi scrisoarea de intenţie:

contactează-ne la tel. 079484979

Orange
, we are at the forefront of telecommunications innovation, driving the evolution of cloud technology to deliver seamless connectivity and transformative experiences for our customers. We are seeking a talented and motivated
Telco Cloud Engineer
to join our team.
In this role, you will design, implement and optimize cloud-based solutions tailored for the telecommunications sector. vacancy-content:
Azure DevOps Engineer
We’re growing fast and are looking for
DevOps Engineer
professionals at all levels to work on an exciting international software development project. You’ll work with the latest technologies in our bright, talented team. The environment at Amdaris is synergistic and supportive, so everyone can build the career they want in an organization going from strength to strength. Willingness to be part of a team and lead by example is essential.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As an
Azure DevOps Engineer
, your primary role is to collaborate with software engineers, system operators, and other IT professionals to manage code releases and optimize cloud infrastructure within a suite of software applications, primarily hosted in Microsoft Azure. You will help bridge the gap between software development, testing, and operations teams, assisting with Azure-based systems integration, cloud database management, and the management of critical applications in the Azure ecosystem.
In this role, you will need to quickly adapt to evolving business needs, including shifting goals, new technology implementations, and emerging cloud-based solutions. You will be expected to engage, develop, and communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and stakeholders, ensuring smooth operation of cloud infrastructure and software pipelines. A core part of your responsibilities will be to automate and streamline our clients’ software suites on Azure, working on the specification and documentation of new features and ensuring the continuous operation of critical Azure-based applications.
The successful Azure DevOps Engineer will combine technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills, demonstrating deep knowledge of cloud platforms, operating systems, applications, and software, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve application issues. A solid background in Azure DevOps and cloud-based technologies is essential.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Extensive experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role with a focus on Azure.
Strong understanding of Azure cloud services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps pipelines, and Azure App Services.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Bicep.
Hands-on experience in container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker.
Proficiency in managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or similar tools.
Experience in agile software development, working with languages such as Go, C/C++, Java, JavaScript.
Expertise in Windows or Linux operating system environments.
Familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell and Python for automating Azure cloud environments.
Experience with Azure monitoring and logging tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
Strong problem-solving skills, a collaborative mindset, and team-oriented approach.
BENEFITS
Opportunities for certification and training
Internal referrals bonus up to EUR 1.000
Gym allowance
Medical Reimbursement
Full salary covered up to 20 days of sickness
Flexible working hours
Loyalty scheme
Team building activities, special events and conferences
UK/EU Travel opportunities
Snacks and drinks in the office

IOS Developer
Your Invitation to Brilic Media
Simple Apps. Big Impact.
(More than a motto—it’s our way of life.)
Who We Are
Brilic Media was born in 2018, built on a big belief: simplicity is revolutionary.
Since then, we’ve grown into a passionate and precise team, creating mobile apps that quietly improve the lives of over 50 million users worldwide.
Our mission?
To lead the world in mobile innovation—by building experiences that feel like magic but work like clockwork.
What Stays the Same The Brilic Media Benefits
Modern Apple Gear: From day one. No sluggish hardware—just fast, reliable tools to help you do your best work.
Daily Lunch Allowance: 100 MDL every day. Eat well, focus better.
Paid Learning: Online courses, certifications, and training—covered by us.
Supportive Culture: No egos. No bureaucracy. Just a helpful, motivated team.
Real Growth: Career paths based on merit, not politics.
“You’ll feel seen. You’ll feel trusted. You’ll feel the difference.”
iOS Developer
What You’ll Do
Build and refine iOS applications that perform seamlessly and feel intuitive.
Collaborate with designers, PMs, and fellow developers to build new features.
Bring UI/UX designs to life in beautiful, responsive interfaces.
Identify and fix performance issues, bugs, and edge cases.
Write clean, maintainable code—and keep documentation up to date.
Explore and integrate the latest iOS development tools and frameworks.
Preferable Background
2+ years of iOS development experience, with at least one app published on the App Store.
Proficiency in Swift; familiarity with Objective-C is a plus.
Experience working with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and dependency managers like SPM or CocoaPods.
Solid grasp of software design patterns such as MVC and MVVM.
Familiarity with tools like SwiftGen and XcodeGen/Tuist.
Comfortable with multithreading (Dispatch, async/await) and Git version control.
Able to read technical documentation in English (B1+) and communicate effectively.
Reliable, honest, proactive, and a great team player.
Let’s Skip the Corporate Nonsense
We’re not hiring titles—we’re building a team.
If you’re ready to make an impact, grow your skills, and enjoy the ride, we’d love to meet you.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Ваше приглашение в Brilic Media
Простые приложения. Большой эффект.
(Не просто слоган — это наш образ жизни.)
Кто мы такие
Brilic Media появилась в 2018 году с одной большой идеей:
простота — это революция
.
С тех пор мы выросли в команду, полную страсти и точности, создающую мобильные приложения, которые тихо, но ощутимо улучшают жизнь более
50 миллионов пользователей по всему миру

Your Invitation to Brilic Media
Simple Apps. Big Impact.
(More than a motto—it’s our way of life.)
Who We Are
Brilic Media was born in 2018, built on a big belief:
simplicity is revolutionary.
Since then, we’ve grown into a passionate and precise team, creating mobile apps that quietly improve the lives ofover
50 million users worldwide.
Our mission?
To lead the world in mobile innovation—by building experiences that feel like magic but work like clockwork.

Modern Apple Gear:
From day one. No sluggish hardware—just fast, reliable tools to help you do your best work.

Daily Lunch Allowance:
100 MDL every day. Eat well, focus better.
•
Paid Learning:
Online courses, certifications, and training—covered by us.
•
Supportive Culture:
No egos. No bureaucracy. Just a helpful, motivated team.
•
Real Growth:
Career paths based on merit, not politics.
“You’ll feel seen. You’ll feel trusted. You’ll feel the difference.”
Senior Android Developer (Kotlin)
What You’ll Do
•
Develop and Optimize Applications:
Design, build, and maintain high-performance, reusable, and reliable Kotlin code for Android applications.
•
Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams:
Work closely with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver seamless and user-friendly apps.
•
Troubleshooting and Debugging:
Identify and fix bugs, performance bottlenecks, and other technical issues to ensure a smooth user experience.
•
Maintain Code Quality:
Ensure best practices in code structure, design patterns, and testing through code reviews and continuous improvement processes.
•
Stay Updated:
Keep up with the latest Android development trends, tools, and technologies to integrate innovative solutions into the apps
Preferable Background
•
Professional Experience:
3+ years of Android development experience, with a strong focus on Kotlin.
•
Technical Proficiency:
Expertise in Kotlin, Android SDK, and modern tools like Jetpack Compose, Retrofit, and Room Database.
•
Methodologies:
Familiarity with Agile development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and unit/UI testing frameworks like Espresso.
•
Soft Skills:
Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, and a proactive attitude toward learning and improvement.
•
Languages:
English at B1 level or higher (ability to read technical documentation).
•
Qualities:
Strong work ethic, honesty, reliability, stress tolerance, punctuality, and excellent communication skills.
Let’s Skip the Corporate Nonsense
We’re not hiring titles - we’re building a team.
If you’re ready to make an impact, grow your skills, and enjoy the ride, we’d love to meet you.

Простые приложения. Большой эффект.

Brilic Media появилась в 2018 году с одной большой идеей:
простота — это революция.
С тех пор мы выросли в команду, полную страсти и точности, создающую мобильные приложения, которые тихо, но ощутимо улучшают жизнь более

Проектировать, разрабатывать и поддерживать производительные, надёжные и масштабируемые Android-приложения на Kotlin.

Плотно сотрудничать с продакт-менеджерами, дизайнерами и backend-разработчиками для создания удобных и качественных приложений.

Senior PHP Developer (1800-2500 USD)+
iFLY is Hiring: Senior PHP Developer
Full-time
At
iFLY
, we are a leading international travel agency with a strong presence across Europe and the United States. We specialize in creating
personalized
and
innovative travel experiences
, powered by a team of creative and passionate professionals.
We’re now looking for a talented
Senior PHP Developer
to join our growing team and take our travel platforms to the next level!
Your Role
As a
Senior PHP Developer
at iFLY, you will:
Lead the development and maintenance of server-side components using PHP.
Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements.
Design and optimize MySQL database structures for performance and scalability.
Build scalable, high-performance solutions for our global travel platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
Mentor junior developers and support the team's technical growth.
Drive innovation by contributing to new features and ideas.
What We’re Looking For
We’re seeking someone who has:
5+ years of experience in PHP development.
Strong knowledge of PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
Experience with OOP, RESTful APIs, and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with front-end technologies (React, Next.js, Vue, HTML, CSS) — a plus!
Experience with cloud platforms — a bonus.
Proactive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and team spirit.
Passion for travel and tech innovation.
What We Offer
Competitive salary + bonuses for seniority and expertise.
Flexible, supportive work environment focused on work-life balance.
Meal tickets, office perks (coffee, fruits, snacks).
Access to sports facilities & regular team-building events.
Travel opportunities through project-related experiences.
Professional development: trainings, certifications, conferences.
Referral bonuses for bringing new talent on board.
Why Join iFLY?
You’ll be part of a young, dynamic team where
tech meets travel
. At iFLY, your work will help redefine how people plan and enjoy their journeys around the world. If you’re a seasoned PHP developer ready for a fresh challenge in an exciting industry,
this is your opportunity
.
Let’s build the future of travel — together.
Apply Now

join@enwardo.md
We can't wait to meet you!

Administrator de Sistem
Compania Enter - își lărgește echipa și este în căutarea unui Administrator de Sistem.
We create togetherness. Împreună putem fi de neoprit!
Cum știi dacă te potrivești rolului?
Experiență de lucru într-o poziție similară de cel puțin 1 an.
Cunoștințe despre principiile de funcționare ale rețelelor locale și ale componentelor acestora.
Abilități de administrare Windows și de lucru cu echipamentele periferice.
Responsabilitate, atenție la detalii și capacitate de a lucra în echipă.
Ce trebuie să faci:
Administrarea și întreținerea rețelelor locale (TCP/IP, rutare, firewall, VPN, WiFi).
Administrarea sistemelor de operare Microsoft Windows (7, 8, 10, 11).
Instalarea, configurarea și diagnosticarea software-ului aplicațiilor.
Conectarea, configurarea și întreținerea echipamentelor periferice (imprimante, scanere etc.).
Rezolvarea promptă a problemelor IT ale utilizatorilor.
De ce să te alăturați echipei – ENTER!
Progres, progres, progres!
Enter crește exponențial de mai bine de-un deceniu. Avem planuri ambițioase și ne încăpățânăm să le facem realitate!
Profesionalismul nostru face diferența!
Profesionalismul este cartea noastra de vizită pe care o reconfirmăm permanent în relația cu clienții noștri!
Suntem adaptabili și ne reinventăm permanent!
Ne reinventăm permanent astfel încat să fim în pas cu așteptările clienților noștri dar și cu evoluția industriei IT!
Încurajăm neordinarul!
Suntem o gașcă, avem personalitate și nu ne temem s-o exteriorizăm. Încurajăm oamenii cu atitudinea de vino-ncoa, ne fascinăm de gândirea out-of-the-box și stimulăm generarea de idei noi în medii degajate!
Oferim oportunități de dezvoltare personală și profesională!
Creăm și asigurăm membrilor echipei noastre mediul propice dezvoltării și punerii în valoare a abilităților și creativității!
Dacă te-am intrigat, vrem și noi să ne uimesti.

Познакомьтесь с нами:
Hot Software
за динамику и открытость, поэтому в нашей компании царит предпринимательский дух, сочетание азарта и сплоченности, страсть к успеху. Мы создаём высокопродуктивную среду и не боимся преград. Мы часто выходим из своей роли, проявлять инициативу и настойчивость, умение адаптироваться там, где это необходимо.
Наш стиль - избегать бюрократии, упрощать процесс связи сотрудников с руководством, внедрять корпоративные правила только там, где это реально необходимо. Нам важна лёгкость общения и личные качества. Мы принимаем в команду только тех людей, которые не просто обладают необходимой компетенцией, но и способны как минимум сохранить уже заданную культурную планку.
Культура:
Наш успех основан на людях и технологиях. Наша культура — это то, что делает Hot Software интересным и вознаграждаемым местом для работы. Мы выступаем за разнообразие и всегда ищем новые способы удивить клиентов.
Наши ценности:
развитие
амбиции
командная работа
ответственность
гибкость
Требования
Знание операционной системы: Linux.
Знание серверов: Nginx, Cloudflare. Знание фреймворков: Fastly, Express.
Опыт работы 5+ лет с: MySQL, NoSQL, Couchbase, PostgreSQL, Redis.
Знание бэкенда: Typescript, Node.js.
Знание Rest API, протоколов Soap.
Навыки юнит-тестирования.
Знание системы управления версиями Git.
Понимание основных принципов фронтенд-разработки.
Опыт в декомпозиции и описании задач для разработки на основе бизнес-требований.
Опыт работы в команде, проведение кодового обзора.
Опыт взаимодействия с смежными отделами (дизайн, управление, бэкенд, тестирование и т.д.).
Навыки написания запросов к базе данных и проектирования баз данных.
Обязанности
Тестирование и отладка кода, исправление ошибок.
Написание юнит-тестов как на своем, так и на чужом коде.
Поддержка и масштабирование существующей функциональности.
Участие в проектировании новых частей системы.
Проведение кодового обзора.
Взаимодействие с коллегами: консультация коллег, уточнение задач, обсуждение функциональности, предложение идей и т.д. Разработка логики приложения.
Что мы предлагаем:
Медицинское страхование;
Ежемесячная компенсация спортивных занятий;
Бюджет на самобразование
Оплачиваемое обучение по повышению скиллов
Self-review каждый год (повышение ЗП)
Сертификат на день рождения
Компенсация на проезд (общественный транспорт)
Referral bonuses (система бонусов по рекомендации кандидатов)
Гибридный формат работы (офис/удалено)
Если вы хотите иметь то, что никогда не имели, вам придётся делать, то что никогда не делали.

Full-Stack Web Developer (PHP-Laravel)
A UK-based digital marketing group is hiring in Moldova. After developing and releasing a number of projects in the business intelligence and online gaming space we are looking to strengthen our presence in Moldova.
About the Role
We are looking for a
Full-Stack Web Developer
with a strong focus on
front-end development
to join our team. The ideal candidate should have experience working with
WordPress (Elementor), PHP, Laravel, and front-end technologies
to build and optimize responsive web applications and landing pages.
This role will involve developing and maintaining high-quality front-end solutions while also handling
back-end logic
where necessary.
Responsibilities
Front-End Development
Design, develop, and maintain responsive landing pages and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress (Elementor).
Implement UI/UX designs into fully functional, visually appealing, and performance-optimized web pages.
Customize and extend WordPress themes & plugins to meet business needs.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility, mobile responsiveness, and adherence to modern web standards.
Optimize front-end performance for fast load times.
Back-End Development (Secondary Focus)
Develop and maintain custom functionalities in PHP (Laravel).
Work on API integrations, database queries, and back-end optimizations.
Troubleshoot and fix back-end issues when needed.
Skills & Experience
Front-End
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery.
Experience with WordPress (Elementor, Custom Themes & Plugins).
Strong understanding of responsive web design and mobile-first development.
Familiarity with front-end performance optimization techniques.
Back-End
Experience in PHP & Laravel for back-end development.
Ability to write efficient SQL queries in MySQL.
Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and integrations.
Additional Skills
Experience with
Git
for version control.
Ability to troubleshoot issues across both front-end and back-end.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Good English communication skills (written & spoken).
Perks include:
Excellent salary
opportunity to travel to relevant conferences abroad
company-wide performance bonuses
work with a very experienced team towards achieving globally-recognized success
central office location in Chisinau with an option to work remotely on a need-basis
This is a great opportunity to join a funded & fast-growing startup run by experienced entrepreneurs. We only work with people who are motivated, energetic, multi-talented and above all, willing to achieve more.

team-md@identi.com
.
Our aim is to get back to all candidates within 1 week.

vacancy-content:
Unreal Engine Game Developer (15000 - 40000 mdl)
The Midnight Works team is looking for a talented Unreal Engine Developer to join our innovative GameDev team!
Benefits:
Opportunity to be part of an internationally recognized company.
IT Park residency status.
Gym membership.
Underground parking (50% covered by the company).
Flexible salary, agreed upon based on your skills.
Official employment, including social package.
Stable work hours: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday.
Friendly, sociable, young team.
Team-building activities.
Office in the Telecentru area, conveniently located with public transport and nearby lunch spots.
Comfortable office with relaxation area, free tea/coffee, snacks, and fruit.
Key responsibilities:
Implementing Game Mechanics:
Transform design concepts and ideas into functional and engaging game mechanics using Unreal Engine to create an interactive gaming experience.
Level Design:
Create engaging and high-quality game environments by designing and constructing levels that enhance the player experience and interaction.
Performance Optimization:
Improve game performance through collaboration with the development team to ensure smooth and responsive gameplay across different platforms.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Interact with artists, animators and other team members to seamlessly integrate visual elements into the game world.
Problem Solving:
Identifying and addressing technical challenges and optimizing the game to improve its quality and performance.
Tracking Unreal Engine Features:
Monitoring the latest updates and features of Unreal Engine with the aim of integrating new technologies to improve game development and enhance their quality.
Qualifications:
Understanding/Knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++
Understanding and knowledge of 3D and 2D
Experience with version control systems (e.g., git)
Ability to work in a team and strong communication skills
Desire to learn new technologies and professional development
Interested in the position?
Please send your resume to
hr@midnight.works
Submitting your resume implies consent for the processing of personal data.
We look forward to meeting you and contributing to Midnight.Works' success in the Game Development world together!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Echipa Midnight Works caută un Unreal Engine Developer talentat pentru a se alătura echipei noastre inovatoare de GameDev!
Beneficii:
Posibilitatea de a face parte dintr-o companie cunoscută la nivel internațional.
Suntem rezidenți IT Park.
Abonament la sala de sport.
Parcare subterană (50% acoperită de companie).
Salariul flexibil, stabilit de comun acord în funcție de abilitățile dumneavoastră.
Angajare oficială, pachet social inclus.
Program de muncă stabil: 9:00-18:00, luni-vineri.
Colectiv tânăr, amabil și sociabil.
Activități de team-building.
Birou situat în sectorul Telecentru, o zonă bine amplasată, cu transport public și locații pentru prânz în apropiere.
Birou confortabil, cu zonă de relaxare și ceai/cafea, dulciuri și fructe gratuite.
Responsabilități cheie:
Implementarea Mecanicilor de Joc:
Transformarea conceptelor și ideilor de design în mecanici de joc funcționale și captivante, folosind Unreal Engine pentru a crea o experiență interactivă de joc.
Proiectarea Nivelurilor:
Crearea mediilor de joc captivante și de calitate prin dezvoltarea și construcția nivelurilor care contribuie la îmbunătățirea experienței de joc și interacțiunii cu jucătorul.
Optimizarea Performanței:
Îmbunătățirea performanței jocului prin colaborarea cu echipa de dezvoltare, cu scopul de a asigura un gameplay fluent și receptiv pe diverse platforme.
Colaborare Interdisciplinară:
Interacțiunea cu artiștii, animatorii și alți membri ai echipei pentru integrarea armonioasă a elementelor vizuale în lumea jocului.
Rezolvarea Problemelor:
Eliminarea dificultăților tehnice și optimizarea jocului pentru a îmbunătăți calitatea și performanța acestuia.
Urmărirea Caracteristicilor Unreal Engine
: Monitorizarea celor mai recente actualizări și caracteristici ale Unreal Engine cu scopul de a implementa noi tehnologii pentru îmbunătățirea dezvoltării jocurilor și creșterea calității acestora.
Calificări:
Înțelegerea/Cunoașterea Unreal Engine și C++
Înțelegerea și cunoașterea 3D și 2D
Experiență în lucrul cu sisteme de control al versiunilor (de exemplu, git)
Abilitatea de a lucra în echipă și abilități puternice de comunicare
Dorința de a învăța noi tehnologii și de a se dezvolta profesional
Pentru a face parte din echipa Midnight Works, expediați CV-ul cu o poză actuală la adresa:
hr@midnight.works
.
*Aplicarea CV-ului implică acordul la prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal.
Așteptăm cu nerăbdare să te cunoaștem și să contribui la succesul echipei Midnight Works în lumea GameDev!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Команда Midnight Works ищет талантливого Unreal Engine Developer, чтобы присоединиться к нашей инновационной команде GameDev!
Преимущества:
Возможность стать частью международной компании.
Мы резиденты IT Park.
Абонемент в спортзал.
Подземная парковка.
Гибкая заработная плата, устанавливаемая по договоренности в зависимости от ваших навыков.
Стабильный рабочий график: 9:00–18:00, с понедельника по пятницу.
Молодой, дружелюбный и общительный коллектив.
Team-building мероприятия.
Офис в районе Телецентр – удобное расположение, рядом общественный транспорт и заведения для обеда.
Комфортный офис с зоной отдыха, бесплатным чаем/кофе, сладостями и фруктами.
Ключевые обязанности:
Реализация игровых механик:
Превращение творческих игровых концепций в захватывающие и функциональные механики, использующие возможности Unreal Engine, чтобы создать уникальный игровой опыт.
Проектирование уровней:
Создание атмосферных и детализированных игровых локаций, которые погружают игроков в увлекательные миры и усиливают их взаимодействие с игрой.
Оптимизация производительности:
Взаимодействие с командой для оптимизации производительности игры, обеспечивая плавный и динамичный геймплей на различных платформах, от ПК до мобильных устройств.
Междисциплинарное сотрудничество:
Тесное взаимодействие с художниками, аниматорами и другими специалистами для бесшовной интеграции визуальных элементов, которые делают мир игры живым и увлекательным.
Решение технических задач:
Применение инновационных решений для устранения технических проблем и улучшения качества игры, обеспечивая плавность игрового процесса и высокий уровень производительности.
Отслеживание новинок Unreal Engine:
Постоянное исследование новых возможностей и технологий Unreal Engine для внедрения в процесс разработки, что позволит улучшить качество и функциональность игры.
Квалификации:
Понимание/знание Unreal Engine и C++
Понимание и знание 3D и 2D
Опыт работы с системами контроля версий (например, git)
Умение работать в команде и сильные коммуникативные навыки
Желание изучать новые технологии и развиваться профессионально

Отправка резюме подразумевает согласие на обработку персональных данных.

Security Specialist
Orange Systems is the IT hub of Orange Moldova. An IT park resident, with over 850 employees, that delivers advanced IT solutions, enhancing a wide range of activities and full cycle development, impacting millions of customers across Europe.
Orange Systems is looking for a new colleague to fill in the position of
Security Specialist to work with our International Partners
.
The Security Specialist is a critical role within the Security Operations team and is responsible for ensuring the ongoing determination of the current security environment, log and event monitoring, incident response, audit, and spot checks. The role is also heavily involved in the ongoing implementation and support of information security systems, policies, and processes, and to ensure business information systems and processes adhere to security policies and standards and comply with regulatory and customer requirements.
Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate a deep interest in Cyber and Information Security. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has been in the field for a while (3+ years) and looking to take on more responsibilities to develop their career.
what you will be doing:
Ensure that the company’s IT systems and data is always kept secure
Primary responsibilities are vulnerability management, security event detection and remediation
Perform ongoing identification of potential risks & probable business impact
Recommend and initiate controls to protect against identified risks
Participate in and occasionally lead the security incident management process and the investigation of breaches of information security and recommend appropriate control improvements
Responsible for deployment and management of security systems and security software
Assist in the selection, design, justification, implementation and operation of information security controls and management strategies
Promote, information security awareness across the organisation
Respond to help desk and planned work requests ~ resolve or manage problems of a complex or urgent nature
To assist in designing and documenting infrastructure support processes, procedures, and standards and to maintain documentation as directed
what we are looking for:
Any relevant industry certifications (i.e. CompTIA Security+, (ISC)2 SSCP, AZ-900 Azure Fundamentals, AWS Certified Security) will all be considered
Excellent knowledge of the Security industry
Knowledge of ISO27001:2022 standard, GDPR
Knowledge of security frameworks and methodologies such as CIS, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-61, OWASP top 10
Excellent commercial awareness
Infrastructure background
what's in it for you:
Unique learning experience in our company
Working experience with great potential for growth
Competitive salary
Benefits and compensations that you can discover on
https://www.orange.md/?l=1&p=1&c=1&sc=5
We invite you to join Orange for a unique learning and working experience, with great potential for growth in an innovative environment.
If you share the same views, apply today!
Working for Orange is one of a kind experience. Come check it out!
Orange Systems

vacancy-content:
Senior Fullstack Engineer
About Roslin
Roslin is a technology-enabled business services company. We specialize in improving business performance for some of America’s largest ground transportation providers. Every day our team delivers a next-generation customer experience and helps transportation companies better connect with their customers.
We develop turnkey systems that feature real-time dispatching, vehicle location, and tracking, as well as computerized routing and scheduling, integrated billing, and cashiering. An innovator in data dispatching, we provide market-specific application software, mobile and portable device interfaces and infrastructure products.
Project description:
Currently, we are building an intelligent fleet management platform for dispatch, billing and cashiering that seamlessly connects multiple transportation fleets with clients via one system. We offer both an intuitive, intelligent technology and a strong partnership for transportation providers, delivering savings, simplicity and accounting transparency.
The platform includes multiple different services, mobile and web applications.
Responsibilities:
Participation in the estimation and planning of development tasks
Designing and implementing new features, extend existing.

vacancy-content:
Web Engineer
Purcari Wineries Group
stands as one of Moldova's premier wine producers and exporters, with a prestigious reputation on the international stage. We command a significant share of the Moldovan premium wine market (approx. 30%) and are a major player in exports (approx. 20%). Our distribution network impressively spans over 25 countries across Europe (including Norway, the UK, Romania, Ukraine, Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Germany, Belarus), Asia (China, Japan, South Korea), and North America (Canada and the USA). Join a leading company with a rich heritage and a dynamic international presence.
Who we are looking for:
We're seeking a versatile and adaptable
Web Engineer
who thrives on working with diverse technologies rather than being limited to a single platform or language. We value engineers who understand the full lifecycle of web development, from concept to deployment and maintenance. You should be comfortable tackling challenges across the stack and collaborating effectively.
Specifically, we expect you to have:
Polyglot Programming Skills:
Demonstrable experience and proficiency in several programming languages. We frequently work with or value knowledge in Node.js, PHP, Elixir, and Go Lang. Strong JavaScript skills are fundamental.
Solid Frontend Foundations:
Proven experience with core web technologies like HTML and CSS, including building responsive layouts that work across devices and implementing CSS animations.
CMS Expertise:
Hands-on experience with a variety of Content Management Systems (CMS). Significant expertise with WordPress is highly important, given its current use within our projects.
Full-Stack Capability:
The ability to design and build websites and web applications "from the ground up," demonstrating an understanding of web architecture beyond just using CMS templates.
Infrastructure Fundamentals:
Basic knowledge and practical experience with configuring and managing components like web hosting, DNS, basic Linux server configuration, and deployment processes. An appreciation for web security best practices is essential.
Collaborative Spirit:
Experience working effectively alongside designers, SEO specialists, and potentially other marketing or technical stakeholders to bring projects to life.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality websites and web applications.
Work extensively with various CMS platforms, particularly WordPress, including customization, theme/plugin development, and troubleshooting.
Build new web solutions from concept through implementation, potentially without relying on existing CMS frameworks.
Collaborate closely with design teams to translate UI/UX designs into functional web experiences.
Work with SEO specialists to implement technical SEO requirements.
Manage and configure aspects of the web infrastructure, including hosting environments, DNS settings, and basic server tasks.
Ensure websites are responsive, performant, and adhere to security best practices.
Diagnose and resolve bugs and performance issues across the web stack.
Nice to Have:
Experience with cloud hosting platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Advanced knowledge of web security principles and mitigation techniques.
Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker).
Experience with database management (SQL, NoSQL).
Previous experience in e-commerce platforms or the beverage/wine industry.
Working language:
English is the primary and official working language.
Proficiency in Romanian or Russian is a plus but not mandatory.
Location:
This position can be based in either Chișinău, Moldova or Bucharest, Romania.

Senior Golang Developer
We are looking for a Senior Golang Developer to join our Trevolution team within Dyninno Group travel division.
Trevolution
is a global leader in air ticketing and travel services, serving retail and corporate clients in 50+ markets. With over 20 years of expertise and an entrepreneurial spirit at our core, we combine modern tech with a customer-first approach to simplify travel. As the 4th-largest US airline ticket consolidator, we partner with 70+ airlines, offering a full booking experience with expert support – focused on value and convenience. Our products, including online sales, call bookings, and semi-OTAs, are continually expanding to meet market trends.

Senior Golang Developer
you will be responsible for helping to build scalable, high-performance communication and platform services. You will be working on mission-critical backend services, developing APIs, and optimizing distributed systems for high availability and efficiency.
Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and secure backend services using Go / Node.Js/ PHP.
Design and implement APIs, microservices, and messaging systems for communication and platform solutions.
Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
Work with cloud platforms and containerization technologies like Docker & Kubernetes.
Implement real-time messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance platform capabilities.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Requirements:
Proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience developing backend services.
Strong understanding of concurrent programming, microservices architecture, and RESTful APIs.
Experience with message queues and real-time communication protocols.
Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases.
Experience deploying and managing applications in the cloud.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps practices.
Understanding of security best practices, authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT), and API gateways.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
What will be considered an advantage:
Prior experience in high-availability, large-scale system design.
Compensation:
The range for this position is between 3,800 EUR gross and 4,600 EUR gross per month depending on the applicant’s professional experience in the relevant field.

vacancy-content:
Senior Data Engineer (Databricks, AWS)
About the job
We’re growing fast and are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (AWS) to join our team and work on an exciting international software development project. You’ll work with the latest technologies alongside our bright, talented team. The environment at Amdaris is synergistic and supportive, so everyone can build the career they want in an organization that is going from strength to strength.
JOB DESCRIPTION
The role of the Data Engineer is fundamental in the delivery of a best-practice business intelligence infrastructure that will contribute to the delivery of high-quality data analytics in line with business priorities. The successful candidate will be focused on architecting, building, managing, and optimizing data pipelines/models and then moving these pipelines/models effectively into production for key data and analytics consumers (including, but not limited to, MI Analysts and Data Scientists). They will need to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders to identify the optimal ways in which requirements can be achieved.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop and maintain data models and schema designs that support our business needs.
Apply standard data modelling and design techniques based upon a detailed understanding of requirements.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into technical solutions.
Work with product teams to ensure that data pipelines meet their needs.
Monitor the performance of data pipelines and resolve issues as they arise.
Ensure that data is accurate, reliable, and available.
Develop and maintain documentation for data infrastructure and pipelines.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Strong experience with ETL/ELT, data modeling, and data integration
Deep understanding of SQL
Mandatory experience with Databricks
Experience with business intelligence tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.)
Experience with Databricks or other managed data analytics platforms
Strong experience with AWS cloud services, including AWS Glue and AWS Redshift or AWS Aurora
Experience building a data warehouse on AWS
Nice to have experience with Snowflake
Data modeling, data ingestion, data orchestration
Good knowledge of software development practices such as versioning, CI/CD
Knowledge of programming languages (Python)
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English
BENEFITS
Opportunities for certification and training
Meal bonus
Internal referral bonus up to EUR 1.000
Gym allowance
Medical Reimbursement
Full salary covered up to 20 days of sickness
Flexible working hours
Opportunity to work abroad up to 20 days a year
Loyalty scheme
Team building activities, special events and conferences
UK/EU Travel opportunities
Snacks and drinks in the office

Data Steward & ETL Developer
We're seeking a Data Steward
to become part of our team.
Key Responsibilities:
Responsible for the maintenance of Business Metadata of Datasets and Data Elements (Columns, Tables, Schemas) in quality high and in sync with the Information Models
Develop and maintain the data flow map, understand all connections of the currently (and steadily increasing) end to end processes across the involved functions and processes within as well as beyond own Data Domain.
Support Data Domain Owner with analysis of DQ issues and creation of mitigation strategies
Contribute to the Design and implementation of processes to clean, transform, and aggregate raw data into the curated data layer.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of logic data models that accurately represent business entities and relationships.
Contribute to updates to the curated data layer to accommodate changes in logical models or business needs.
Implement data quality checks, define test scenarios, carry out testing and define validation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Identify and troubleshoot data issues, perform root cause analysis and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.
Facilitate data classification, metadata management, and data lifecycle management.
Develop and maintain data documentation and metadata repositories.
Qualification and Expertise:
MSc or BSc in Informatics, Data Science or equivalent
Experience with AWS services related to data processing and analytics.
Experience with SQL and database programming.
Knowledge of data modeling, ETL development, and data warehousing principles.
Experience with data quality tools, data cataloging and modeling, and metadata management (e.g. Innovator)
Experience with Veeva Vault is a plus.
Required Skills and Competencies:
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data quality and accuracy.
Proactive in identifying and resolving data issues

Daily shared lunches

Referral bonus for internal and external recommendations
Fun ways to relax: PlayStation, table tennis
Corporate events for employees
Beverage fridge, free coffee, tea, fresh fruits
Modern equipment
Official employment and social package
Modern and comfortable workplace

Он будет реализовывать игровую механику, интегрировать графические и аудиоэлементы, а также обеспечивать оптимальную производительность игры. Он будет тесно сотрудничать с командами по игровому дизайну, UI/UX и художниками, чтобы воплотить видение команды в реальность. Кроме того, он будет способствовать поддержке кода, обеспечивая соответствие лучшим практикам индустрии.
Обязанности:
Разработка и оптимизация игровых функций в Unity, используя язык программирования C#.
Реализация механики геймплея в соответствии со спецификациями игрового дизайна.
Интеграция графических, аудио- и анимационных элементов в Unity.
Разработка и оптимизация VR-взаимодействий для максимально плавного и захватывающего опыта.
Быстрое создание прототипов для тестирования новых концепций геймплея.
Обеспечение совместимости и оптимизация игры на различных VR-платформах и консолях.
Написание чистого, модульного и легко поддерживаемого кода, соблюдая принципы ООП (объектно-ориентированного программирования) и SOLID.
Использование инструментов профилирования и отладки для диагностики и улучшения производительности игры.
Работа с UI-системами Unity (UI Toolkit, Canvas, TextMeshPro и т. д.).
Использование и разработка Scriptable Objects для управления игровыми данными.
Активное сотрудничество с командами дизайна и QA для тестирования и оптимизации.
Четкое документирование разработанных систем для облегчения долгосрочной поддержки кода.
Требования:
Демонстрируемый практический опыт работы с Unity и C#, включая разработку VR-игр (преимущество).
Уверенные знания оптимизации производительности в Unity, включая опыт работы с LOD (Level of Detail), occlusion culling и batching.
Опыт использования Unity Physics Engine и реализации физической механики.
Знакомство с VR-системами ввода (Oculus SDK, OpenXR, SteamVR и т. д.).
Опыт работы с сетевым мультиплеером (Photon, Mirror, Netcode for GameObjects – преимущество).
Знание шейдеров и материалов в Unity (Shader Graph, HLSL – преимущество).
Навыки отладки и профилирования с использованием Unity Profiler, RenderDoc, Deep Profiling и т. д.
Опыт интеграции и управления сторонними плагинами в Unity.
Способность работать в гибкой среде, основанной на методологиях Scrum.
Опыт использования систем контроля версий (Git).
Отличные навыки командной работы, внимание к деталям и способность самостоятельно решать проблемы.
Хорошие коммуникативные навыки и навыки документирования для облегчения межотдельского сотрудничества.
Знание английского языка на разговорном уровне.
Что мы предлагаем:
Инновационные проекты в постоянно расширяющейся области.
Доступ к современному оборудованию.
Дружелюбная, ориентированная на сотрудничество и профессиональное развитие рабочая среда.
Бюджет на обучение и участие в профильных мероприятиях.
Медицинская страховка и другие привлекательные бонусы.
Если вы хотите стать частью команды, которая превращает идеи в VR-опыт, отправьте нам свое резюме и портфолио Мы с нетерпением ждем встречи с вами!

Basic understanding of IT Security principles.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and time management skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and collaboration skills.

End-result oriented mindset and ability to lead incident resolution from start to end.

Modern new office in Chisinau, Sculeni (Calea Iesilor, 6A).
Engagement with a global travel organization - operating in a modern and dynamic team where everyone’s opinion matters.
Hands-on experience with industry-defining innovative trends.

Мы — распределенная команда из более чем 40 профессионалов — разработчиков, аналитиков, финансовых экспертов, стремящихся предоставить безупречный опыт торговли. Наша платформа доступна на 21 языке и обслуживает трейдеров во многих странах мира, делая мировые рынки более доступными, чем когда-либо.

Manual QA Engineer
, который добавит свой опыт в нашу команду из 5 QA. Эта новая роль поможет нам ускорить разработку.

Проведение функционального и нефункционального тестирования клиентских (веб + мобильные) и серверных приложений.
Создание тест-кейсов и чек-листов.
Выявление и документирование ошибок; воспроизведение и анализ сложных дефектов.
Анализ логов и данных для определения корневых причин проблем.
Сотрудничество с командой для улучшения процессов тестирования и повышения качества продукта.
Проведение пользовательского приемочного тестирования (UAT) и участие в принятии решений по выпуску.
Оценка результатов релизов и предложение улучшений для повышения стабильности и качества программного обеспечения.
Требования:
Опыт работы в качестве Software Tester или QA Engineer более 5 лет.
Способность анализировать требования и разрабатывать тест-кейсы и тестовые сценарии.
Отличное знание методологий тестирования программного обеспечения и практический опыт их применения.
Опыт тестирования веб, мобильных и серверных приложений.
Знание REST API и уверенное владение такими инструментами, как Postman, Swagger или их аналогами.
Опыт использования Jira, Confluence, TestRail и инструментов для анализа логов.
Опыт работы с финансовыми приложениями (брокерские терминалы, инвестиционное или торговое программное обеспечение и т. д.).
Мы предлагаем:
Офис в центре города Кишинев.
Корпоративные и тимбилдинг мероприятия для сотрудников.
Членство в IT-парке: официальное трудоустройство, 28 календарных дней отпуска, оплачиваемые больничные.
Ежегодный пересмотр заработной платы;
Напитки, бесплатный кофе, чай, свежие фрукты.
Современное оборудование для работы.
Relax-зона на территории офиса;
Корпоративная библиотека;
Компенсация стоимости абонементов в фитнес-клуб;
Талончики на обед Up Dejun.
