Your Invitation to Brilic Media
Simple Apps. Big Impact.
(More than a motto—it’s our way of life.)
Who We Are
Brilic Media was born in 2018, built on a big belief: simplicity is revolutionary.
Since then, we’ve grown into a passionate and precise team, creating mobile apps that quietly improve the lives of over 50 million users worldwide.
Our mission?
To lead the world in mobile innovation—by building experiences that feel like magic but work like clockwork.
What Stays the Same The Brilic Media Benefits
Modern Apple Gear:
From day one. No sluggish hardware—just fast, reliable tools to help you do your best work.
Daily Lunch Allowance:
100 MDL every day. Eat well, focus better.
Paid Learning:
Online courses, certifications, and training—covered by us.
Supportive Culture:
No egos. No bureaucracy. Just a helpful, motivated team.
Real Growth:
Career paths based on merit, not politics.
“You’ll feel seen. You’ll feel trusted. You’ll feel the difference.”
PHP Backend Developer (Laravel)
What You’ll Do
Design and develop REST APIs for iOS/Android apps
: scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Refactor legacy codebases
: improve performance, readability, and align with modern Laravel standards.
Maintain and enhance existing projects
: implement new features and optimize infrastructure.
Integrate third-party services and AI models
: e.g., GPT, Gemini, S3, external APIs.
Deploy and support via CI/CD workflows
: using Docker, Git, and Linux for reliable delivery and monitoring.
Preferable Background
Strong backend foundation:
3+ years with PHP and 1+ year using Laravel in real-world projects.
Database expertise:
Confident working with MySQL/PostgreSQL — schema design, queries, and optimization.
REST API & CI/CD experience:
Skilled in building and integrating RESTful services, with solid CI/CD understanding.
DevOps-ready:
Hands-on with Docker (including docker-compose), Git (Gitflow), and Linux-based workflows.
Solid software engineering skills:
Proficient in OOP, design patterns, data structures, and clean code principles.
Languages:
English at B1 level or higher (ability to read technical documentation).
Qualities:
Strong work ethic, honesty, reliability, stress tolerance, punctuality, and excellent communication skills.
Let’s Skip the Corporate Nonsense
We’re not hiring titles—we’re building a team.
If you’re ready to make an impact, grow your skills, and enjoy the ride, we’d love to meet you.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Ваше приглашение в Brilic Media
Простые приложения. Большой эффект.
(Не просто слоган — это наш образ жизни.)
Кто мы такие
Brilic Media появилась в 2018 году с одной большой идеей:
простота — это революция
.
С тех пор мы выросли в команду, полную страсти и точности, создающую мобильные приложения, которые тихо, но ощутимо улучшают жизнь более
50 миллионов пользователей по всему миру
.
Наша миссия?
Вести за собой в мире мобильных технологий — создавая продукты, которые ощущаются как магия, но работают как часы.
Преимущества в Brilic Media
Современное оборудование Apple:
С первого дня — никакого медленного железа. Только быстрые, надёжные инструменты для комфортной работы.
Ежедневный обед:
100 MDL каждый день — вкусно, удобно, без хлопот.
Оплачиваемое обучение:
Курсы, сертификации, тренинги — за наш счёт.
Поддерживающая культура:
Никаких эго, никакой бюрократии. Только доброжелательная и мотивированная команда.
Настоящий рост:
Карьерные возможности по заслугам, а не по статусу.
«Вас заметят. Вам будут доверять. Вы почувствуете разницу.»
PHP Backend Developer (Laravel)
Ваши задачи
Проектировать и разрабатывать REST API для iOS/Android приложений
— масштабируемые, безопасные и простые в поддержке.
Рефакторить унаследованные кодовые базы
для повышения производительности, читаемости и соответствия современным стандартам Laravel.
Поддерживать и развивать текущие проекты
— внедрять новые функции и оптимизировать инфраструктуру.
Интегрировать сторонние сервисы и AI-модели
(например, GPT, Gemini, S3, внешние API).
Выполнять деплой и сопровождение через CI/CD-конвейеры
с использованием Docker, Git и Linux для надёжной доставки и мониторинга.
Кого мы ищем
Опыт:
минимум 3 года с PHP и хотя бы год реальных проектов на Laravel.
Уверенно работает с MySQL и PostgreSQL:
умеет проектировать схемы, писать сложные запросы и оптимизировать их.
Знаком с REST API и CI/CD:
знает, как строить надёжные веб-сервисы и автоматизировать их деплой.
Готов к DevOps-задачам:
работает с Docker (включая docker-compose), использует Git по Gitflow и комфортно чувствует себя в Linux-среде.
Владеет основами инженерии:
ООП, паттерны проектирования, структуры данных и принципы чистого кода для него не пустые слова.
Языки:
Читает техническую документацию на английском уровне не ниже B1.
Личные качества:
отличается надёжностью, честностью, стрессоустойчивостью, пунктуальностью и умеет понятно и в срок коммуницировать с командой.
Давайте пропустим корпоративную ерунду:
Мы не нанимаем должности — мы создаем команду.
Если хотите делать что-то значимое, развиваться и кайфовать от процесса — будем рады знакомству!

vacancy-content:
Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer
Join
Purcari Wineries Group – A Leader in the Wine Industry!
Purcari Wineries Group is one of Moldova’s premier wine producers and exporters, commanding ~30 % of the domestic high-quality wine market and ~20 % of exports. Our distribution network reaches 25 + countries across Europe, Asia and North America.
As part of the Purcari tech team you will help shape an ambitious digital transformation—building drone-based viticulture tools, ML-driven quality control, and a brand-new Kubernetes cloud platform. You’ll drive Infrastructure as Code, Policy as Code, end-to-end automation, and much more. Come join us at the intersection of winemaking tradition and engineering innovation!
Role
Ensure the reliability, scalability and security of Purcari’s cloud and on-prem environments.
Design, build and own our automation tool-chain—CI/CD pipelines, IaC modules, observability stack and incident-response processes.
Operate a hybrid infrastructure: Azure / AWS clouds, edge compute in vineyards, and on-site datacenter & manufacturing networks.
Mentor junior DevOps engineers and champion a culture of continuous learning and blameless post-mortems.
Participate in a shared on-call rotation to diagnose and resolve production issues.
Responsibilities
DevOps Lifecycle
- Orchestrate seamless collaboration between development and operations teams throughout build-test-release-operate stages.
Automation & IaC
- Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi or CloudFormation) and automate provisioning, deployments and testing.
CI/CD
- Design, implement and maintain robust pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Argo CD, Tekton).
Cloud & Containers
- Manage and optimise multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters, Docker images, service meshes and autoscaling policies.
Monitoring & Logging
- Build and tune unified observability (Prometheus/Grafana, Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
Incident Management
- Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and permanent fixes; drive SLO/SLA adherence.
Security
- Enforce “shift-left” security, harden supply chain, manage secrets, run vulnerability scans & policy as code (OPA, Kyverno).
Networking & Hardware
- Support LAN/WAN, fibre, Wi-Fi and factory-floor equipment; assist with small datacenter operations.
Mentoring
- Guide junior engineers, document best practices and evangelise DevOps culture company-wide.
Continuous Improvement
- Stay current with emerging tools and practices; prototype and introduce innovations that enhance developer productivity and system resilience.
Requirements
5 + years
of hands-on DevOps / SRE experience in production environments.
Expertise with
Kubernetes
and container ecosystems (Helm, Kustomize, Operators).
Strong IaC skills with
Terraform
(preferred) or CloudFormation/Pulumi, plus configuration management (Ansible, Chef, or similar).
Proven track record designing and running
CI/CD
pipelines and test automation frameworks.
Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (
Azure
or
AWS
) and familiarity with hybrid/on-prem setups.
Solid grasp of
Linux internals
, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, HTTP, VPNs, firewalls), and hardware basics for small datacenter operations.
Experience building comprehensive
monitoring, logging and tracing
solutions.
Competence in one scripting language (Bash, Python, Go, etc.) and ability to contribute to tooling.
Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills; comfortable analysing production incidents under pressure.
Understanding of
security best-practices
: IAM, secrets management, container hardening, compliance controls.
Excellent documentation habits and a passion for knowledge-sharing and mentorship.
Bonus: exposure to industrial IoT, edge computing, drone operations or manufacturing networks.
What We Offer
Opportunity to influence the architecture of a modern, end-to-end digital winemaking platform.
A collaborative culture that values innovation, ownership and continual improvement.
Competitive salary, performance bonuses and wine perks.
Flexible work arrangements and support for professional development & certifications.
Raise a glass to world-class engineering—apply today and help us craft the future of winemaking technology!

Java Developer
Ești pasionat de modelarea viitorului sectorului bancar prin soluții software inovatoare?
Căutăm un
inginer software
talentat care să se alăture echipei noastre dedicate revoluționării experiențelor bancare zilnice.
În calitate de
inginer software
specializat în operațiuni bancare zilnice, vei juca un rol esențial în proiectarea, dezvoltarea și întreținerea aplicațiilor software de ultimă generație care sporesc eficiența, securitatea și confortul operațiunilor bancare zilnice pentru mulți clienți.
Produsele noastre sunt sisteme bazate pe evenimente construite folosind microservicii Spring Boot care comunică prin REST și mesagerie.
Avem tendința de a decupla cele mai complexe modele de codul de infrastructură, folosind arhitectura hexagonală.
Serviciile rulează în containere care sunt orchestrate de Kubernetes.
Echipa de ingineri este auto-organizată, unde toată lumea este implicată în acumularea de cunoștințe de domeniu și în îmbunătățirea proceselor de inginerie.
În acest rol vei avea următoarele sarcini:
Vei contribui activ la dezvoltarea produselor bancare, participînd la toate fazele ciclului de viață al dezvoltării, fiind parte a unei echipe multifuncționale;
Vei asigura calitatea prin scrierea de cod testabil, prin realizarea cu teste automate;
Vei fi implicat în revizuirea designului și a codului, asigurînd respectarea standartelor de calitate;
Vei integra și implimenta continuu modificări de producție, menținînd un mediu de dezvoltare agil și efficient.
Competențe și abilități care te fac potrivit/potrivită pentru această funcție:
Experiență în dezvoltarea aplicațiilor backend folosind limbajul Java 3+ ani sau mai mult.
Experiență în crearea de aplicații, construire microservicii și configurarea acestora folosind Spring Boot.
Experiență în dezvoltarea și implementarea de aplicațiilor web RESTful folosind Spring MVC.
Experiență în securizarea API-urilor folosind Spring Security.
Experiență în accesul și manipularea datelor prin Spring Data, Hibernate.
Experiență în modelarea datelor, optimizarea interogărilor și administrarea bazelor de date PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server.
Experiență în implementarea modelelor de mesagerie distribuită folosind RabbitMQ.
Experiență cu diferite strategii de testare (Unit, Integration, Component).
Cunoașterea Docker, Kubernetes - avantaj.
În echipa maib vei beneficia de:
Mediu de muncă profesionist, inovator, creator de tendințe în banking și nu doar, dar și oameni care te vor inspira în ritmul agile;
Oficiu modern și amplasat ultracentral, cafea, zone de relaxare, sală de sport, bucătărie, terasă, etc;
Tichete de masă;
Credite imobiliare și alte servicii bancare în condiții preferențiale;
Asigurare medicală privată sau abonament la sala de sport;
Flexibilitate de a lucra hibrid;
Oportunități de dezvoltare profesională și personală, teambuildinguri;
Gamă largă de reduceri la partenerii
maib
.
Expediază CV-ul la adresa
resurseumane@maib.md
, indicând funcția pentru care candidezi și hai să excelăm profesional împreună.
*Vor fi invitate la interviu doar persoanele selectate. În funcție de caz, CV-ul tău ar putea fi analizat și pentru alte poziții vacante din cadrul
maib
.
Îți mulțumim pentru interes! Ne vom bucura să ne cunoaștem și să facem echipă comună în cadrul
maib
!

You will participate in requirements analysis and prioritise tasks, collaborate with internal teams to produce software design and architecture and revise, update, refactor and debug code.
As a
.NET Developer
, you will have to develop documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC) and serve as an expert on applications, providing technical support for programs and applications to customers and other team members. You will have to engage with key stakeholders, both internal and external, providing expertise and technical leadership to functional project teams.
The successful
.NET Developer
will use analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions that may include a variety of complex business requirements and troubleshoot technical programs, products and applications and redesign programs as needed to make them more efficient and effective. You will need to have the ability to learn new products and technologies as they become available to find the best methods for using them.
REQUIREMENTS
Proven experience as a .NET Engineer
Previous experience with WPF
Familiarity with the ASP.NET (including Core) framework, SQL Server and design and architectural patterns
Knowledge of at least one of the .NET languages (e.g. C#, Visual Basic .NET) and HTML5/CSS3
Familiarity with architecture styles/APIs (REST, WCF)
Advocate of Agile methodologies
Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
Familiarity with Azure platforms and CI/CD pipeline in the cloud
Knowledge of TDD and BDD approaches in software development
Strong attention to detail
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English
BENEFITS
Opportunities for certification and training
Internal referral bonus up to EUR 1.000
English courses
Gym allowance
Medical Reimbursement
Full salary covered up to 20 days of sickness
Flexible working hours
Loyalty scheme
Team building activities, special events and conferences
UK/EU Travel opportunities
Snacks and drinks in the office

Senior Integration Developer
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Integration Developer to join our team and play a crucial role in designing and implementing integration flows across our mobile-first fintech platform. The ideal candidate will possess solid expertise in integration technologies, including Java, REST, SOAP, XML, XSD, XSLT, and various messaging platforms such as MQ, KAFKA, and RabbitMQ.
You will collaborate closely with system analysts to design efficient integration solutions and with QA to automate integration testing, ensuring the seamless functionality of our services.
Responsibilities:
Integration Design:
Collaborate with system analysts to design and implement efficient integration flows and systems, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements;
Automation of Integration Testin
g: Work closely with QA teams to design and automate integration tests, ensuring seamless, high-quality interactions between systems.
Security
: Partner with the Security Team to ensure all integrations adhere to the latest security standards, following best practices for data protection, encryption, and compliance.
Systems Integration
: Utilize your expertise in Java, REST, SOAP, XML, XSD, XSLT, JSON, Messaging with MQ, Data Streaming (KAFKA, RabbitMQ, JMS), and various other technologies to develop robust integration solutions across platforms.
Communication
: Maintain effective communication with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth collaboration and timely delivery of integration solutions. Required Qualifications:
Technical Expertise
: Strong knowledge of Java, REST, SOAP, XML, XSD, XSLT, JSON, Messaging with MQ, KAFKA, RabbitMQ, JMS, WSO2, SoapUI, SQL, and GraphQL.
Integration Experience
: Proven experience in designing and implementing complex integration flows and automating integration testing.
Security Awareness
: Deep understanding of security principles and a demonstrated ability to work with security teams to implement and maintain high security standards.
Collaboration Skills
: Ability to collaborate across multiple teams (System Analysts, QA, Security) to design, test, and deliver solutions that meet business and technical needs.
Problem-Solving
: Excellent analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in a mobile-first fintech environment.
Familiarity with cloud-based integration solutions (AWS, Azure).
Strong experience with agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.
If you are passionate about building secure, high-quality integrations in a mobile first fintech company, we would love to hear from you!
Personal Attributes:
Self-driven and able to work independently as well as within a team environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, scalable solutions.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

resurseumane@maib.md
, indicating the position you are applying for, and let’s excel together professionally.

1.job_description: Who We Are At Extole, our mission is to give everyone, everywhere the ability to participate in the brands they love and be recognized and rewarded. Our market-leading advocacy platform powers referrals for major brands like Uber, Airbnb, and Starbucks—if you’ve ever referred a friend to a favorite service, you’ve experienced how personal and powerful word of mouth can be. We’re also a #oneteam culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. We share goals, hold each other accountable, and celebrate our collective wins. We believe that innovative solutions come from supportive teams who challenge each other to grow. What You’ll Do We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives on tackling complex technical challenges while working across the stack. In this role, you will: Build and Innovate: Design and develop high-performance, scalable applications using our modern tech stack (Java, REST, Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, Terraform, AWS). You’ll be expected to lead by example and deliver production-ready code with a long-term perspective. Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with peers in code reviews and architectural discussions, while actively mentoring junior and mid-level engineers. You’ll help raise the technical bar for the entire team. Enhance User Experiences: Optimize front-end features for speed and usability, ensuring consumers enjoy an intuitive, seamless experience—and helping guide front-end best practices when needed. Own and Drive: Take full ownership of product areas, define KPIs to measure success, and drive initiatives from concept through to production. You’ll be trusted with key decisions and expected to lead delivery efforts. Improve Processes: Research, recommend, and implement new tools, techniques, and best practices that keep our engineering team efficient and forward-thinking. Contribute to #oneteam: Participate in sprint planning and cross-functional meetings, aligning technical efforts with business goals and helping steer product direction with your insights. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly power referral experiences used by millions of people worldwide. Learning & Growth: Join a team committed to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. We regularly hold internal tech talks, hackathons, and encourage ongoing professional development—even more so for our senior engineers. #oneteam Culture: We collaborate, support each other, and celebrate successes together—because we’re stronger as one. Awesome Office & Competitive Pay: Enjoy our welcoming office in central Chișinău, with a highly competitive salary and the latest equipment to help you do your best work. Comprehensive Benefits: Paid sick leave and vacation, private health insurance, and a healthy work-life balance ensure you have the support you need both inside and outside of work. What We’re Looking For Software Development Experience: You have several years of experience building and shipping real-world applications, working in production environments, and taking ownership of complex systems. Java Expertise: Proficiency in Java (or any typed language) with a solid understanding of object-oriented design, common design patterns, and building robust, maintainable applications. Agile Mindset: Comfortable working in iterative sprints, adapting to changes, and delivering continuously—with an ability to lead by example. Tooling & Platforms: Experience with GitHub or similar version control, Gradle/Maven, and a knack for navigating Linux or macOS environments. Communication Skills: Fluent in English with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to influence decisions through your experience. Nice to Have Educational Background: BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field Big Data & Cloud: Experience with Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, Terraform, and AWS Database Skills: Strong grasp of relational databases, SQL, and efficient data modeling Spring Framework: Familiarity with Spring or similar frameworks to build scalable, maintainable services Front-End Familiarity: Comfort working with Vue or other modern JavaScript frameworks Ready to Join the Team? If you’re excited by the idea of shaping the future of advocacy marketing, building impactful software at scale, and being part of a supportive #oneteam, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and let’s discover what we can build together at Extole! Powered by JazzHR SYYNeUpPbn Show less

3.job_description: About Us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust user interfaces using pre-built component libraries. This position is ideal for a developer who thrives in a structured environment, enjoys translating design requirements into efficient, scalable code, and is dedicated to delivering seamless, intuitive user experiences. If you thrive in a results-driven environment, value autonomy, and enjoy building intuitive, scalable UI without subjective design guesswork, this is the role for you. Key Responsibilities Frontend Development Develop high-quality user interfaces using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, leveraging UI libraries such as NextUI, HeroUI, and Tailwind CSS. Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code, ensuring optimal performance and responsiveness across browsers and devices. Create and maintain reusable frontend components. Backend Development Develop robust backend services and high-quality Edge functions. Write clean, efficient, and scalable backend code. Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and scalability. UI Implementation & Design Integration Accurately translate design wireframes and layouts into functional frontend implementations. Ensure consistency, usability, and accessibility throughout all UI implementations. Optimize interfaces for maximum performance and user experience. Collaboration & Process Collaborate effectively with product managers and backend developers to understand requirements and deliver integrated solutions. Participate actively in code reviews and maintain high coding standards. Contribute to efficient workflows and seamless transitions between design and development phases. Qualifications 3-5 years of frontend development experience (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind). 2+ years of backend experience using Nest.js Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and ability to work within structured design systems. Proficiency with HTML and CSS; capable of delivering clean, semantic, maintainable code. Familiarity with UI component libraries (NextUI, HeroUI, or similar). Solid understanding of responsive and adaptive design principles. Good knowledge of SQL Experience with design tools such as Figma or Visily to implement assets accurately. Extensive knowledge of backend development, including service creation and scalable database solutions Good SQL knowledge Strong knowledge of Git and version control best practices. Nice to have Experience working with design systems and component-based architecture. Background in D2C product development or performance marketing. Experience optimizing accessibility and usability. Portfolio demonstrating frontend implementation skills across multiple projects Location Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. 96.job_description: About the job Job Description We're looking for part-time Developers / IT freelancers with Python, JavaScript, and/or Java experience to train & tutor our AI models. Our goal? Advance the field of artificial intelligence through collaborative Generative AI projects with domain experts. The Mindrift platform allows experts to dive into a variety of tasks ranging from creating training prompts for AI models to refining AI responses for better relevance. You’ll have the unique opportunity to contribute to AI development anywhere, at anytime. Flexible, community-focused, and innovative—without the need for developer skills. 161.job_description: About the job R Systems is seeking a talented Edge AI Machine Learning Engineer with specialized expertise in embedded GPU/NPU acceleration to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience in developing and optimizing AI inference models for embedded GPU/NPU architectures. If you are a skilled Edge AI Machine Learning Engineer with a passion for pushing the boundaries of edge computing and GPU/NPU acceleration, we want to hear from you! Apply now to be part of our dynamic and collaborative team and join us in shaping the future of AI at the edge and revolutionizing industries with innovative Edge AI solutions! Your Contribution Develop and optimize AI inference models for deployment on edge devices with embedded GPU/NPU accelerators, focusing on low-latency inference runtimes. Implement and fine-tune low-latency inference pipelines to meet real-time performance requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI inference solutions into edge computing platforms and applications. Conduct performance profiling and optimization to maximize the efficiency of GPU/NPU acceleration for Edge AI inference. Influence the Edge AI strategy by providing expert advice on design and architecture Stay current with advancements in GPU, NPU, and Edge AI frameworks, incorporating them into solution designs as appropriate. Provide technical expertise and support to project teams, ensuring successful implementation and deployment of Edge AI solutions. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI model development and deployment, with a focus on edge computing and inference runtime optimization. Experience in developing full Edge / On Prem AI Application based on: NLP, Time Series (Sensors) processing, etc. Python strong programming skills in languages. Optional: C/C++ Proficiency in ML frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost) with focus on edge AI applications deployment (e.g., Glow, TFLite, TensorRT) Experience with MLOps frameworks (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow, TFX, Airflow, H2O) Extensive experience with GPU/NPU acceleration for AI inference, including optimization techniques (tensor, pipeline, data, sharded data parallelism) and performance tuning, Hands on experience with one or more GPU/NPU frameworks: CUDA, Vulkan, OpenCL, familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson, ARM Mali, or relevant SoC configurations. Knowledge of parallel computation, memory scheduling, and structural optimization Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a passion for innovation and continuous learning. Additional Skills (Preferred) Experience with edge device hardware and software integration. Familiarity with edge computing architectures and IoT platforms. Experience with edge AI applications in domains such as robotics, autonomous vehicles, or industrial automation

190.job_description: About the job As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises. We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities. A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation. Location: we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones What your day will look like In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might: take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there work on technical articles, presentations or workshops identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide present at conferences, meetups or technical events What we are looking for in you A strong candidate is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers) understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding builds trust, relationships and confidence is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Muncă 100% remote: spune adio drumurilor lungi până la birou - lucrează de oriunde! Faci parte dintr-un StartUp lider în educație, unde inovația și dezvoltarea personală sunt la ordinea zilei. Aplică aici: https://airtable.com/shrFxZePXcsuaY9Mb

768.job_description: About the job 04.06.2025 Șef al Direcției cooperare tehnică externă și colaborare bilaterală Anunț nou Scopul Direcției: Direcția cooperare tehnică externă și colaborare bilaterală îşi desfășoară activitatea având ca scop asigurarea unei coordonări eficiente, la nivel instituțional, a activităților de cooperare tehnică externă a BNM, precum și a activităților de cooperare bilaterală a BNM cu alte bănci centrale și autorități de supraveghere, precum și alți parteneri externi. Stagiu de cel puțin 5 ani în structurile administrației /autorităților publice naționale/instituții financiare sau în structurile internaționale, cu funcții ce țin de relații internaționale și/sau coordonarea comunicării între diferite entități, inclusiv în proiecte de asistență tehnică (beneficiar /donator de proiecte de asistență tehnică); Cunoștințe de operare a calculatorului la nivel de utilizator și cunoașterea avansată a aplicațiilor MS Word, Excel și Power Point; Competențe lingvistice: cunoașterea limbii române, ruse și engleze vorbire fluentă; Cunoașterea specificului activității instituțiilor financiare internaționale și altor organizații internaționale care au tangență cu atribuțiile BNM; Cunoașterea particularităților de bază a procesului de integrare europeană; Cunoașterea particularităților ce țin de coordonarea asistenței tehnice externe acordate de comunitatea donatorilor, în special a particularităților aferente: (i) identificării /programării necesităților de asistență tehnică, ținând cont de obiectivele prioritare ale BNM; (ii) inițierii /purtării dialogului cu partenerii de dezvoltare în vederea obținerii de asistență tehnică externă pentru BNM; (iii) implementării, monitorizării și evaluării proiectelor și programelor de asistenta tehnică externă; Cunoașterea prevederilor legale cu privire la Banca Națională a Moldovei, privind activitatea entităților reglementate, licențiate și supravegheate de către BNM, privind reglementarea valutară etc. necesare pentru realizarea cu succes a atribuțiilor postului; Cunoașterea atribuțiilor principalelor autorități (instituții) publice ale Republicii Moldova (în special cele cu profil economic și financiar); Competențe: integritate, responsabilitate, profesionalism, lucru în echipă, orientare către rezultate, credibilitate, capacitate de a rezolva probleme, perseverență, învățare și dezvoltare continuă; Alte abilități și atitudini: candidatul trebuie să posede abilități de analiză și luarea deciziilor, flexibilitate, capacitatea de a soluționa probleme, de a prioritiza și a gestiona mai multe sarcini simultan; spirit de echipă și de inițiativă, gândire ordonată și analitică, atenție la detalii, tact şi pricepere în muncă cu oamenii, perseverență, rezistență la efort şi stres; capacitate de ascultare și spirit de analiză, capacitate de comutare rapidă la diverse probleme profesionale – dezvoltare foarte bună; capacitate de a expune clar și concis, scris și verbal: constatările, concluziile și recomandările (fixarea exactă și calitativă a informației), capacitate de sinteză; operativitate în rezolvarea sarcinilor; atitudine pozitivă, constructivă. Cerințe Ce Vor Constitui Un Avantaj: Experiență managerială în structurile administrației /autorităților publice naționale sau în structurile internaționale, cu funcții ce țin de relații internaționale și/sau coordonarea comunicării între diferite entități, inclusiv în procesul integrării europene. Principalele Atribuții Funcţionale: Organizarea și coordonarea activității Direcției CTECB; Cooperarea cu partenerii externi de dezvoltare în vederea solicitării și beneficierii de asistență tehnică externă; Coordonarea și gestiunarea (prin planificarea, solicitarea, monitorizarea și evaluarea rezultatelor) tuturor misiunilor de asistență tehnică externă de care beneficiază BNM, sau este oferită de către BNM; Monitorizarea participării reprezentanților BNM la formațiunile de lucru ale organizațiilor externe și informarea periodică a membrilor CE cu privire la aceasta; Asigurarea colaborării cu celelalte subdiviziuni din cadrul BNM pentru realizarea oricăror acțiuni comune legate de băncile centrale și autoritățile de supraveghere din alte state, inclusiv cele ce privesc încheierea și implementarea de acorduri/memorandumuri de cooperare între BNM și acestea; Asigurarea întreprinderii măsurilor necesare în vederea bunei organizări a întâlnirilor din cadrul BNM și a evenimentelor asociate, desfășurate cu ocazia vizitelor reprezentanților partenerilor externi; Participarea în cadrul activităților de elaborare a documentelor de politici naționale de dezvoltare social-economică a Republicii Moldova, precum și privind integrarea Republicii Moldova în structurile economice internaționale; Asigurarea elaborării și redactării scrisorilor protocolare (de felicitare pentru numirea în funcție, mulțumire, colaborare, condoleanțe etc.) ce urmează a fi adresate partenerilor externi ai BNM; Asigurarea elaborării unor analize, sinteze, discursuri, prezentări și în limba română, rusă sau engleză, în legătură cu participarea membrilor CE, sau a altor reprezentanți ai BNM la diverse reuniuni şi forumuri, sau alte evenimente externe; Îndeplinirea altor funcții și însărcinări la indicația Conducerii BNM. Beneficiile Oferite De BNM: Experiență profesională într-o bancă centrală; Oportunități extinse de dezvoltare profesională și personală; Mediu de muncă modern și prietenos; Flexibilitate în programul de muncă; Pachet salarial competitiv; Atmosferă dinamică într-o echipă de profesioniști. Chişinău, Departamentul strategie, organizare şi resurse umane, cu specificarea postului pentru care doriţi să candidaţi. 780.job_description: About the job About Mixbook Mixbook is the #1 rated photo book service in the US, with over 30K 5-star reviews, empowering over 6 million people to design and share their one-of-a-kind stories. We're a profitable, growing company known for our intuitive design platform, exceptional quality, and fanatical customer service. But Mixbook is more than just a product - we're a team of passionate individuals driven to make a difference. What truly sets Mixbook apart is our commitment to creating a workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. We value collaboration, open communication, and a growth mindset. We believe in empowering our team members to take ownership, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact. Our culture is built on a foundation of trust, constructive feedback, and a shared passion for delivering outstanding results. If you're looking for a place where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard, and you can grow alongside a talented team, then Mixbook is the place for you. Job Description Mixbook Moldova is a place where far more than just work happens. It’s a place where our team has the opportunity to connect with each other, take creative risks, and engage with our community with the goal of achieving our mission: to empower creativity and deepen human connection. We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) to join our team at Mixbook Moldova, where you'll have the opportunity to make a difference in the world of creativity and human connection. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and product owners to design, implement, and deploy innovative systems that scale with our growing business and technical needs. Your insights on code architecture and building developer-friendly APIs will be highly valued. We prioritize meaningful and highly impactful contributions over busy work, ensuring you are always engaged with what truly matters at any given time. This is the right place and time for anyone seeking the excitement of a start-up but with evolved operations, a great culture, and career enrichment and advancement. We are seeking candidates based in Moldova, where a hybrid work model is available at our office in central Chisinau. What You’ll Do Work closely with product owners to design, implement, and deploy systems that support our growing technical needs. Scale our product using modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, and AWS. Contribute to system design, architecture, and code reviews, ensuring high-quality, scalable solutions. Spend 75% of your time coding, with the rest dedicated to team collaboration and technical decision-making. Foster strong collaboration within a cross-functional team, including marketing, operations, design, and product management. Actively engage in team development initiatives, training sessions, and events to enhance overall team growth and knowledge-sharing. What You’ll Need 5+ years of web development experience Proficiency in both back-end and front-end programming languages and frameworks. Experience with React or Ruby on Rails is a strong plus. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure (ideally, AWS) Previous exposure to back-end databases would be a plus Knowledge of writing a variety of automated tests Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools Opinions on code architecture and building developer-friendly APIs Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams Intermediate English speaking skills, level B2 or greater Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or another related college degree What You’ll Enjoy Market-Leading Salary and Perks: Enjoy a market-leading compensation package that reflects your talent and contributions. Collaborate in an Inspiring Environment: Join a small, agile, and dynamic engineering team that encourages innovation and creativity. Unlimited PTO and Flexible Work Schedule: Embrace a healthy work-life balance with our unlimited paid time off policy and flexible schedule options. Invest in Your Growth: Benefit from personal budgets dedicated to learning and development, team-building activities, enriching your professional and personal journey. State-of-the-Art Office: Work in a high-tech, modern office located in the heart of Chișinău, designed to inspire and enhance productivity. Our Mission & Culture At Mixbook, our mission is to empower people to be creative and connect deeply with the ones they love. Unlike most growth companies, we have invested deeply in culture - because we believe that when we love our people, they will love our customers, and our customers will love our business. You'll contribute to a product loved by millions and help people create lasting memories. You'll thrive in a healthy culture that values collaboration, growth, and open communication. You'll work with talented individuals who are passionate about what they do, and you'll enjoy competitive benefits and perks to support your well-being. We want people to join us who exude our core values: Scrappy: We act like entrepreneurs, taking ownership and finding creative solutions. Caring: We have a heart of empathy, supporting each other and our customers. Craftsmanship: We have a spirit of excellence, striving for the highest quality in everything we do. If you're ready to join a team that's making a real difference in the world, we encourage you to apply!

784.job_description: About the job OUR HIRING PROCESS: We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment. We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team. At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team. From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live. After all, we consider our team members our family, and we want you to feel comfortable and welcomed. INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy INFUSE Academy is an educational platform built to empower B2B marketers and sales teams to achieve demand excellence. We also build learning experiences for our internal teams to help them grow and perform at their best. We’re growing quickly and are looking for creative, driven video editors who are passionate about content quality, smart workflows, and innovative tools like AI. Role Overview We’re hiring a Video Editor & LMS Specialist who can combine strong video production skills with hands-on LMS experience. You’ll be editing a variety of learning content and managing our learning platforms – ensuring seamless learner experiences from content creation to course delivery. If you're tech-savvy, love well-organized systems, and thrive on both creative and operational tasks, this hybrid role is for you. Key Responsibilities Edit video-based training content using Adobe Premiere Pro and other simple editing tools (including human footage, AI-generated speakers, and screencasts). Manage and maintain our LMS (Learning Management System), including course setup, user management, testing, and reporting. Support LMS migrations or set up from scratch, ensuring a smooth transition and clean course structure. Collaborate with instructional designers and stakeholders to ensure accurate, accessible content delivery. Apply automation and explore AI tools to streamline LMS and content workflows. Ensure high standards of usability, design, and learner experience across all platforms. Troubleshoot technical issues related to the LMS and liaise with vendors if needed. What We’re Looking For Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (experience editing educational content is a plus) Proven experience managing LMS platforms (e.g., Thinkific, TalentLMS, Docebo, Moodle, etc.). Experience setting up an LMS from scratch or managing a migration process is a plus Passion for improving learner experience through smart design and technical efficiency A proactive approach to problem-solving and optimizing workflows Interest in automation and AI tools for content delivery and platform management Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects independently in a remote environment. What We Offer A fully remote role with a flexible, international team. The chance to shape and grow a learning ecosystem with real impact. Opportunities to upskill in video, design, LMS tech, and emerging AI tools. A dynamic, collaborative team that values initiative, creativity, and autonomy. Career development within a fast-evolving digital learning environment.

Experience defining configuration specifications, reporting, and alerting requirements. Proficiency with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, TFS). Basic SQL knowledge is an advantage. 2348.job_description: About the job OUR HIRING PROCESS: We will review your application against our job requirements. We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team. At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). 2430.job_description: About the job If you’re here, it’s because you’re looking for an exciting ride. A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone. We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together. Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores. We operate in more than 1500 cities across 23 countries. Together we revolutionise the way people connect with their everyday needs, from delivering essentials to connecting our ecosystem of users through innovative solutions powered by technology. For us, every day is filled with purpose. What makes our ride unique? 🤝 Our culture and strong values. 💪 Our career development philosophy. 🤝 Our commitment to being a force for good. We have a vision: Building the largest marketplace in your city, to give access to anything in minutes. And this is where your ride starts. The Journey Groceries Senior Manager is a management position in charge of grocery chains (e.g. Linella, Bonus etc), pharmacies (e.g. Farmacia Familiei), IT shops (e.g. Bomba), flower shops and everything else that is not a restaurant Responsibilities include: Devise the short-term and mid-term strategy to grow the business in Moldova (e.g. increase the number of orders and users) Bring new shops or grocery chains to sell through the app Manage the existing accounts, ensuring they offer on the app the same levels of service and selection as they do in their own shop Improve operational metrics, alongside the Operations Team (e.g. offer the lowest delivery time we can for the orders made through the app) Oversee the P&L Manage your direct reports, as well as the extended, indirect team Work with a cross-functional local team (marketing, finance, procurement…) to achieve your goals Participate in global strategy meetings where you will work with the regional and global team to ensure the country is aligned with Glovo’s overall strategy Evaluate strategic opportunities, performing (together with your team) a broad range of quantitative and qualitative analyses. Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds - all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard. Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life? Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website!

2547.job_description: About the job What does an IT Product Manager do? IT Product Manager is responsible for the development, improvement and implementation of Unifun services in mobile operators: Assigns and controls the execution of project members’ tasks (Software Developer, System Administrator, Content Manager); Daily interacts with employees of mobile operators (email, Skype, Viber, WhatsApp, etc.); Develops and coordinates with mobile operators the concepts, goals and main stages of the project; Implements products, according to agreements with mobile operators, and also optimizes the products based on their requirements; Participates in the creation of new product features; Improves the Unifun products functionality and performance; Is engaged in the constant increase the revenue of the launched services; Sets tasks for the IT and marketing departments, and monitors their implementation; Monitors and provides support of running projects; Maintains and prepares project documentation (product description, functional description, business case, project plan, test case, etc.); Controls the reports and revenues of the launched projects. Who are we looking for? We do not care about previous work experience and diplomas of the candidate; We are ready to hire an employee, even without a university degree; There can be no work experience at all! It Is Important For Us That The Candidate Is mega-communicative and attentive to detail; Is super-motivated – to work based on the principle “I see the target, don’t see the barriers”; Has a good memory to learn quickly new information; Can clearly and correctly express the ideas – verbally and in writing; Is fluent in English, both verbally and in writing; Is not lazy, not afraid to work hard and take responsibility; Has a sense of humor =) Why work in Unifun? Unlimited volume of work – every IT Product Manager chooses how much he wants to work and can do, and depending on this, how much he will earn. A clear and transparent bonus system – every IT PM receives % of revenue from the services he has launched. A very friendly, young, efficient and driving team! The complete absence of “brakes” and bureaucracy in the company! All decisions in the company are taken very quickly! Interesting work, product management in Unifun is a mix of analytics, product work, creativity, sales. Fast professional development – we have many internal courses, trainings, colleagues who are ready to share best practice with you. An opportunity to get a lot of knowledge in IT, telecommunications, programming, system administration, marketing, as well as gain practical experience in these areas. Perspective for IT Product Manager in Unifun To start earning a lot and quickly, if not to be lazy; To learn how to work productively and efficiently, at a high professional level; To become the leader of a group of IT Product Managers, the head of a product team; To start traveling a lot around the world, meeting with our customers on location when launching Unifun services. Payment Terms Salary depends directly on the productivity of IT Product Manager; Salary is reviewed every 3-6 months; A clear and transparent bonus system depending on the revenue generated by the products that IT Product Manager launches and runs.

2577.job_description: About the job Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 100+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 5,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator’s top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $12 billion valuation and $800 million in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. The role in a nutshell: This role will manage the full payroll process including receiving, validating, and completing payroll related data activities on behalf of the company. The role will also take full ownership of all client communications, ensuring timely responses, follow-through, and resolution of client inquiries. Responsibilities: Establish, maintain, and develop strong and trusted client relationships that result in high client satisfaction, acting as a primary day to day contact for assigned clients; Ensure timely receipt and delivery of payroll data by payroll scheduled; Engagement with local in-country payroll providers to meet delivery timelines while minimizing escalations; Responsible for timely and accurate submission of all payroll data to required partners and/or clients; Responsible for on-time receipt and delivery of net pay and payroll reports in line with agreed upon payroll schedules; Ensure reconciliation and validation of data according to predefined payroll processing procedures and standards; Managing inquiries from clients, internal regional service centers, and local offices via our case management tool, ensuring full resolution in line with company Service Level Agreements; Develop and drive action plans and root cause analysis reports for issues, as required; Participate in the development of processes and procedures for the team following customer and business requirements; Detailed focus on quality, accuracy, and timeliness of payroll related activities as assigned; Serve as subject matter expert (SME) of payroll processes; Adhere to compliance audit controls and requirements; Additional duties as required. Qualifications: Experience in payroll processing - ideally in local payroll legislation: Germany; Fluent German and a good level of English, both written and verbal; Past experience on German SAGE HR suite software engine would be a plus; Passion for service excellence; Strong relationship management; Setting high standards for quality and quantity; Analytically minded with strong attention to detail; Accuracy with record keeping and reconciliation; Demonstrates an ability to learn and think quickly; Ability to work in a fast-paced pressurized environment; Follows procedures and policies and keeps to schedules; Strong verbal and written communication skills; Payroll/HR/Finance/Systems background with an understanding of the core competencies of the payroll process; Experience in a multi-national shared service environment; Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. 2910.job_description: About the job At certain point of your studies you are making decisions about your future career considering all kinds of information, listening to friends and close people, but there is nothing like your own experience. An internship at PwC not only offers an opportunity to build your skills and confidence, but also to work on client projects that give you insight into who we are and what we do whether for our clients, the economy, or the wider community. Working alongside specialists in your chosen business area, you’ll be a valued member of the team, with graduate level responsibility. You’ll be assigned to client projects to develop your understanding of what we really do and you’ll build networks with your colleagues and peer groups. Whichever business area you choose, we’re sure you’ll find this a worthwhile investment of your time. Be it the clients; the people; the networks; or the social events, you’ll be surprised at the skills you’ll develop and how much you’ll learn. Opportunity is at the heart of a career at PwC and our Internship offers just that. The role: As an Intern in the Audit Department at PwC Moldova, you will support the core audit engagement team by performing remotely/and in the office certain audit tasks. As an Audit Intern you will: Participate in real auditing projects under the supervision of professional auditors; Prepare statistical and analytical reports; Prepare the information for the colleagues who take part in auditing processes; Gather all the information about the companies’ clients. Why you should join us: You will have the chance to gain experience during projects for companies from various sectors of economy, both large concerns and local family enterprises; You will have the opportunity to work with many different analytics tools, to propose and implement innovative solutions in the area of financial audit; You will gain knowledge about auditing standards and financial reporting; You will join a company which is recognized by young people as the best place to work; You will expand your network of professional contacts. What we offer: Stable employment (full-time or part-time); The opportunity to expand your knowledge and gain new skills; Exposure to external client during the projects; Modern working tools; Team buildings, fun at work and many other integration gatherings. What we are looking for: Students in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd year of studies in accounting, finance, maths, economic science; Team-players interested in developing a career in the Audit field; Good computer skills (Microsoft Office tools); Fluency in English; Availability to work full-time or part-time; A high motivation for professional development and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for people who are ready to invest in their professional development, are motivated and available to work full-time or part-time and have a genuine desire to learn from others but also on their own. n/a

2950.job_description: About the job Here, at Business-Class, we strive to become the number one choice for all premium-class travelers. A mission we won’t be able to achieve without the right people working together hand-in-hand to accomplish the same purpose. We are dedicated to providing the best product, focusing on customer service and satisfaction to gain loyal repetitive clients eager to work with us. The Role We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to take the lead on our data infrastructure. You'll be responsible for the entire data lifecycle, from building and maintaining our data pipelines to ensuring our data is reliable and ready for analysis. While your main focus will be on the core data engineering tasks, you'll also have the chance to explore how we can use AI and machine learning to improve our services and guide our team in this exciting new area. What You'll Do Build and manage our data pipelines using Python and AWS, making sure they are scalable and reliable. Work with data from various sources like APIs, SFTP, and databases (RDBMS). Develop data models that will be used for analytics and machine learning. Ensure our data is clean, accurate, and secure. Work with our analysts, engineers, and product managers to understand their data needs. Keep our data systems running smoothly and troubleshoot any issues that come up. Explore new AI and machine learning technologies and help our team learn how to use them. What We're Looking For A strong foundation in data engineering, with at least 5 years of professional experience. Deep expertise in Python and its data-focused libraries (pandas, pydantic, boto3, awswrangler, requests, PySpark). Hands-on experience with core AWS services, especially Glue, Athena, S3, and Lambda. Proficiency with both SQL and NoSQL databases (like PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB). A solid understanding of data formats like Parquet, Apache Iceberg, CSV, and XLS. You know your way around ETL/ELT processes and data modeling concepts like Star Schema. You have a good grasp of machine learning concepts and have experience deploying models into a production environment. You're a strong communicator who can explain complex technical ideas to people with different backgrounds. It would be a plus if you have: Experience in the travel industry. Familiarity with Salesforce and SOQL. Experience with API development using FastAPI or OpenAPI. Knowledge of Airflow or AWS Managed Flows. An understanding of MLOps, Apache Hudi, or data visualization tools like AWS Quicksight. Relevant certifications from AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake. What We Offer: Official Employment ( IT Park). Hybrid work opportunity. UDEMY Learning and Developing Free Courses. O'reilly Learning. Corporate lunches. Tasty Coffee, snacks and fresh fruits.

2964.job_description: About the job OUR HIRING PROCESS: We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment. We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team. At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team. From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live. After all, we consider our team members our family, and we want you to feel comfortable and welcomed. INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy INFUSE is looking for a highly organized and driven individual to join our amazing Team! As part of our dynamic team, your responsibilities in this role will include: Produce on-strategy, on-brand presentation materials, including sales sheets, presentation templates for business development, and sales training materials Deliver strong conceptual thinking and visual execution Maintain a superior attention to detail Stay updated on industry trends, and competitor presentations, and design best practices to continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of presentations. Effectively manage your time; meet all deadlines Have a sense of humor and an egoless approach to doing extraordinary work Stay proactive, accountable, and responsive, adapting to any situation Our ideal candidate possesses the following skills: 3-5 years experience working expertly producing presentation graphic design Expert proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Slides Excel at making complex information interesting and easy to understand Experience in the tech (Hardware and Software) Degree in design-related field An inventive, original thinker A self-starter with a strong work ethic Proficiency in English, equivalent to B1 level or higher Additional qualifications that would be considered a plus: Web-design experience Solid skills in Figma, transforming ideas into visual wonders Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe XD If you meet these criteria and are excited about contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply.

2967.job_description: About the job We are looking for a Senior Golang Developer to join our Trevolution team within Dyninno Group travel division. Trevolution is a global leader in air ticketing and travel services, serving retail and corporate clients in 50+ markets. With over 20 years of expertise and an entrepreneurial spirit at our core, we combine modern tech with a customer-first approach to simplify travel. As the 4th-largest US airline ticket consolidator, we partner with 70+ airlines, offering a full booking experience with expert support – focused on value and convenience. Our products, including online sales, call bookings, and semi-OTAs, are continually expanding to meet market trends. As a Senior Golang Developer you will be responsible for helping to build scalable, high-performance communication and platform services. You will be working on mission-critical backend services, developing APIs, and optimizing distributed systems for high availability and efficiency. Responsibilities Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and secure backend services using Go / Node.Js/ PHP. Design and implement APIs, microservices, and messaging systems for communication and platform solutions. Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Work with cloud platforms and containerization technologies like Docker & Kubernetes. Implement real-time messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance platform capabilities. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Requirements Proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience developing backend services. Strong understanding of concurrent programming, microservices architecture, and RESTful APIs. Experience with message queues and real-time communication protocols. Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases. Experience deploying and managing applications in the cloud. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps practices. Understanding of security best practices, authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT), and API gateways. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). What Will Be Considered An Advantage Prior experience in high-availability, large-scale system design. Compensation The range for this position is up to 5,000 EUR net per month depending on the applicant’s professional experience in the relevant field.

2985.job_description: About the job We’re building the most powerful media network in retail. Want in? Footprints AI is scaling fast across Central & Eastern Europe and we’re looking for sharp, driven media sales professionals to help us grow the next big thing in advertising: retail media. This is not another digital media job. We turn real shopper behavior into media audiences. We help brands like Coca-Cola, Unilever, or Heineken reach 25 million real shoppers at the right moment, across 17 of the biggest retailers in the region. And we do it with AI, data, and results. No guesswork. You’ll work directly with top brands and media agencies to: Open doors. Close deals. Launch high-performance campaigns that sell products, not just impressions. What you bring: Experience in digital, media, or brand partnerships (agency, adtech, publishers, retail). Passion for the retail world. Drive. Curiosity. Discipline. The mindset of a builder. You don’t wait for instructions - you create opportunities. Comfort working across markets in CEE. What Footprints AI offers: The chance to shape a new, high-margin media category. Access to the most advanced next-gen retail media AI platform. Ownership. Speed. Growth. A chance to lead, not follow. Great salary & commission package, plus share options. Hybrid, with a preference for Poland, Romania, Croatia, Hungary, Greece, Serbia, Moldova or the Baltics.
2985.company_info: About the company Footprints AI 5,241 followers Follow Technology, Information and Media 11-50 employees 34 on LinkedIn Footprints AI leads the way in retail media solutions, by empowering agencies and brands with a next-gen platform powered by analytics, automation, and proprietary AI. Our retail media platform grants advertisers access to an exclusive network of physical retailers, enabling them to plan and execute in-store and online campaigns with precision, offering real-time insights into sales impact at the product and store level. For physical retailers looking to boost advertising revenue, Footprints AI transforms 100% of customers into targetable media audiences. Both identified and anonymous browsing and purchase behaviors are transformed into media audiences & exclusive audience insights using our proprietary AI technology with 96% accuracy. Our retail partners grow their retail media revenues 10X faster within 3 months, at no costs, while owning & controlling their data. With these technological advantages, proven revenue generating model and strong retail partnerships, Footprints AI is currently operating the most advanced syndicated retail media network in the Central and Eastern Europe region. Our private retail media network is analyzing and monetizing the shopping behavior of over 15 million online and in-store customers on a monthly basis, delivering up to 8X better returns on ad spend and unique media-to-sales attribution for global brands. Our growing list of trusted partners in the CEE region include leading retailers like Profi (Ahold Delhaize), Lagardère Travel Retail, Rimi Baltic, Studenac, Tazz (Wolt Romania), Bolt Food, and more. … show more

3084.job_description: About the job OUR HIRING PROCESS: We will review your application against our job requirements. We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team. Career growth potential within a dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about learning.
